Focus Effect: Look at the top 3 cards of your Fate deck. Discard one of them and add one of them to your focused cards. Draw a card.

name: Silent Struggle
text:
Ninja
Limited: Choose your performing unbowed Ninja Personality: Create a battlefield (not at any province). Only Ninja Personalities will move to it or from it. Assign your Ninja's unit to attack there. Assign another player's target unit to defend there, even if its Personality is bowed. Fight a battle there (after this action's resolution). After the battle ends, lose 5 Honor.

name: My Life Is Yours
flavour: We have no coice but to trust the other clans. The Empire will suffer if they fail us. - Hida Benjiro
text:
Bushido Virtue
Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Samurai: Bow a target enemy Personality with equal or lower Personal Honor. You may target and bow another enemy Personality with a base Gold Cost of 6 or less.

name: Only Actions Speak
text:
Reaction: After an action is announced: Negate all Honor gains until after the action's resolution. At that time, if this negated any gains, negate all Honor gains until the end of this phase and draw a card.
Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Personality: Bow a target enemy card with lower Force and without attachments. Bow its unit if your Personality has 7 or more base Force.

name: Honor & Strength
flavour: Divine One, my magistrates work tirelessly to create stability. With the cooperation of the Crane and the Scorpion, success is assured. - Shosuro Jimen
text: Battle: Choose your performing Magistrate Personality: Target an enemy Personality with lower Personal Honor than your Magistrate's Chi. Move both Personalities home. If the enemy Personality is dishonorable, you may target and straighten a Personality.

name: Fire Blossom
flavour: Chosai knows much about fire, yes. But we have our own store of wisdom, and we are quite willing to share it with him. - Togashi Sho
text:
Kiho
Battle: Choose your performing opposed Monk or Shugenja: Give him two +1F Fire tokens. You may target and bow an enemy card with lower Force (after adding the Fire tokens).

name: Masked in Shadows
flavour: With nowhere to run, and the fog too thick for him to see their arrival, the family believed that Noritoshi would be doomed.
text:
Ninja • Terrain
Battle: If you control a Ninja at this battlefield: While this card is in play, negate other players' actions' effects that move their own non-Ninja Personalities or your Ninja Personalities to or from the current battlefield.

name: Innuendo
flavour: If Lord Noritoshi were so innocent, why has he not appeared in court? Why is he on the run? I will tell you why...
text:
Political
Open: Target a Personality. Unflattering rumors in court distract him. Give him -1F for each of your Courtiers in play.

name: Feinting Position
flavour: Your surveying has done us a great service, Lord Shinjo, the Hida said, "but we have one more task for your men. I promise that your contributions will not be forgotten..."
text: Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Scout, and bow him unless a Recon action has targeted the current battlefield's province this turn: Move a target enemy Personality home. If he moved, gain 2 Honor.

name: A Pure Heart
flavour: A pure heart can drive you to greater heights on the battlefield, but will purity of the heart protect you from the plague?
text: Battle/Open: Choose your performing Paragon: Give him a Force bonus equal to his own Personal Honor.

name: Patrolling the Roads
flavour: Lady Kei is sequestered beneath Jousai Tengen. It is our job to watch the roads so that none approach before the birth of the heir. - Mirumoto Mori
text: Battle/Open: Choose your performing unbowed Magistrate: Target a Personality with lower Personal Honor than your Magistrate's Chi. Reduce the Personality's Force to his own Personal Honor. If his Force is now 0, gain 2 Honor.

name: Reckless Confrontation
flavour: You are a man of honor and dignity, and I... I acted in haste, and shamed my family. I humbly apologize and ask your forgiveness for my actions.
text: Battle: Choose your performing Personality: Reduce the Force of each Personality and Follower in a target enemy unit by your Personality's Personal Honor. Gain 1 Honor for each Personality and Follower in that unit whose Force is now 0.

name: Claw and Shell
flavour: With the Unicorn provoking the undead hordes into advancing on the Crab line, the shock troops of the Crab moved forward, and trapped the monsters between the defensive line and a flanking attack force.
text:
Open: Destroy one or two Personalities or attachments with base Gold Cost of 0.
Battle: Target an enemy Personality. Bow him if he is attacking. Destroy him if his base Gold Cost is 6 or less.

name: Proper Deference
flavour: The hand that wielded the blade was mine, but the honor of the victory was yours, my Lord.
text:
Political Reaction: Before a turn ends, if the active player has gained 8 or more Honor this turn, excluding gains from battle resolution: Set his Family Honor equal to its value when the turn began. Draw a card.
Battle: Give a target Personality or Follower -4F.

name: Narrow Cliffs
flavour: When the Yobanjin approach through the pass, we will have the higher ground. Their forces will be pinned, and the monks should buy us enough time to whittle down their ranks from above. - Ikoma Satoru
text:
Terrain
Battle: Your Ranged Attacks have +2 strength. Other player's Ranged Attacks have -2 strength.

name: Heedless Assault
flavour: The Damned rushed forward and cut through the remaining zombies, heedless of their own injuries.
text: Battle: Give your performing unbowed Berserker Personality a Force penalty up to his current Force: Give a target enemy Follower or Personality an equal Force penalty. Destroy your Berserker if he now has 0 Force and no attachments. Destroy the enemy card if it now has 0 Force and no attachments.

name: Unwavering Commitment
flavour: The delicious irony is that, should Jimen and Noritoshi put aside their differences, they could unite their clans in singular purpose. Fortunately, that will never happen. - Daigotsu Susumu
text:
This card costs 1 less Gold for each unit you control at the current battlefield.
Battle: Move a target enemy Personality home. If you are a Scorpion Clan player, his controller loses 2 Honor.

name: Questionable Charity
flavour: Come with me, friends! Quickly!
text:
Fear • Maho • Kiho
Spider Clan players may play this card paying 1 less Gold.
Limited: Bow your performing Shugenja: Lose 6 Honor. You take in the families of the Dragonfly. Create two 2F/2C/0PH Shadowlands • Undead Personalities.

name: Unexpected Sympathy
flavour: We know what it means to be cast out of one's homeland at the hands of an inhuman enemy. You are welcome here. - Hiruma Todori
text:
Crab Clan players may play this card paying 1 less Gold.
Limited: You take in the families of the Dragonfly. Create two 1F Followers and attach them to one or two of your target Personalities.

name: Asijin's Legacy
flavour: The Tonbo are known for their diplomatic abilities and their unique shugenja schools. Still, the Dragonfly always remember than their Clan's founder was an excellent duelist.
text:
Heroic
Battle: Choose your performing Personality who is a Hero or an Unaligned Human: Choose one of his base abilities. You may use it a second time this turn. You may take an additional Battle action to use that ability.

name: Inexorable Defeat
text:
Battle/Open: Destroy a target Terrain or Region. Lose 2 Honor.
Battle: If any enemy units are at the current battlefield, choose your performing Personality: Move him there. Straighten his unit if he moved. You scorch the earth behind him. If he moved, negate the movement of any other units to that battlefield. Lose 2 Honor.

name: Impetuous Challenge
flavour: Failure to respond quickly means death.
text:
Iaijutsu
Focus Effect: After this duel ends, if the duel's loser did not focus, destroy him.
Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Personality: He challenges a target enemy Personality. Bow the duel's loser's unit.

name: Deathly Aura
flavour: Daigotsu smiled. "You have found the Ebon Daughter's stronghold? I know what we must do."
text:
Dark Virtue
Reaction: After engaging, if you are the Attacker, choose your performing Samurai: You have the first chance to take a Battle action in this battle, which must be performed by that Samurai.

name: Hasty Evaluation
flavour: The wounds of the previous two wars lie deep. The Unicorn Clan and the Lion Clan stand wary of each other's intentions.
text: Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Cavalry Scout Personality, and bow him unless a Recon action has targeted this battlefield's province this turn: Move a target enemy unit home. You may target one of your Personalities and move him to the current battlefield.

name: Concealed Scroll
flavour: Battle is a terrible thing for any soul, even more so for a priest of the kami. But we have our duty, as do all samurai, and we must be prepared for any eventuality. - Isawa Sawao
text: Battle: If you have attached a Spell this battle to a Shugenja who was opposed at the time: Draw 2 cards.

name: Choose Your Fight
flavour: With the wrong location, one can lose a battle before it begins.
text:
Terrain
May be played even if there is already a Terrain at the current battlefield.
Battle: Choose your performing Tactician: Destroy all other Terrains in play. Draw a card.

name: The Wind Never Stops
flavour: The Utaku charged without any sign of fear. Their thunderous assault trampled their foes under their wake.
text: Reaction: After the resolution of a Battle action you took that gave a Force penalty to an enemy Follower or Personality without Followers, choose your performing unbowed Battle Maiden at the current battlefield: Ranged Attack with strength equal to her Personal Honor which must target the enemy card.

name: Overpowering Assault
flavour: Nothing can stand against Rokugani honor and resolve.
text: Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Commander and bow his performing Follower: Destroy a target enemy card without attachments.

name: Thoughtful Present
flavour: The Doji excel in finding the perfect gift for their adversaries, garnering favors and advantage along the way.
text: Open: Bow your performing Artisan Personality and discard the top card of your Fate deck: Target a Personality. Bow him if his Chi is lower than the Focus Value of the discarded card.

name: Mountain Storehouse
flavour: A well-kept secret of the Toturi Dynasty.
text:
Singular
Battle: If any enemy units are at the current battlefield, which must be this province's battlefield unless you are a Lion Clan player, bow this card and choose a performing Personality in your home: Move him to the current battlefield. Straighten his unit if he moved into a defending army.

name: The Oni's Footsteps
flavour: A wretched place, considered cursed and haunted by demons by most who know of it. No one travels there, so it provided the Spider a perfect refuge from the plague.
text:
Shadowlands
Your Shadowlands Personalities with one or more Shadowlands Followers have +1F.
Reaction: After a Personality enters play from this province: Permanently give him Shadowlands.

name: Mouth of the Plague
flavour: We sow our seeds within it, and allow the kami themselves to spread the death of all samurai. The Ebon daughter laughed. "The children of Doji are first, but far from last."
text:
Fire • Mountain • Plague
This province does not hold Dynasty cards unless you are a Crane Clan player.
Battle: Give -1C Plague token to one or two target Personalities.

name: Nitoru
flavour: I carry my father's blade as well as my own. I am warrior enough for both, and I will gladly prove it to any who doubt me.
text:
Ronin • Samurai
Battle: Target an enemy unit with fewer cards than the number of different Clan alignments among Personalities at the current battlefield. Move it home.

name: The Cursed Dead
flavour: Wretched abominations, the likes of which cannot be permitted to exist. - Kuni Daigo
text:
Shadowlands • Undead • Plague
After The Cursed Dead enters play: Lose 4 Honor.
The Cursed Dead will not be destroyed for having 0 Chi.
Battle: Give a target enemy Follower or Personality -4F. If its Force is now 0, bow it.

name: Karatsu
flavour: He gripped the dying ronin's throat, energy crackling along his arm. "I do not care about your foolish legion," he whispered. "I seek my son, Kuronada, and I will hold his heart in my hands as he dies!"
text: Ronin • Shugenja • Cavalry • Commander • Scout • Villain

name: Gutobo - exp
flavour: Flesh makes us strong. Pity there are no more Horiuchi.
text:
Shadowlands • Nonhuman • Goblin • Scout • Experienced • Unique
After Gutobo enters play: Lose 4 Honor.
Battle: If a Recon action has targeted the current battlefield's province this turn: Destroy a target enemy card without attachments.

name: The Quiet Death
flavour: Its form is like that of cloth or cotton, easily torn and easily mended. It wraps around the legs, slowing movement, then forces itself into the throat. Fire alone can destroy it, but also its victims. - The Book of Kuni Mokuna
text:
Shadowlands • Nonhuman • Oni
After The Quiet Death enters play: Lose 3 Honor.
Battle/Open: Target another player's Personality. Negate his movement (this turn).

name: Utaku Yu-Pan - exp2
flavour: The years weigh heavily upon her shoulders. She has seen countless tragedies yet she remains strong of heart and resolve.
text:
Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Battle Maiden • Daimyo • Paragon • Experienced 2 • Loyal • Unique
Your other Battle Maidens have +1F and +1PH while attacking.
Battle: Even if Yu-Pan is bowed: Straighten her. You may target and destroy an enemy Personality or Follower with 0 Force.

name: Utaku Kana
flavour: Kana is only at home on the battlefield - Utaku Yu-Pan
text:
Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Battle Maiden
Kana has +1F while attacking for each other Battle Maiden in her army.
Battle: Give a target enemy Personality or Follower a Force penalty equal to Kana's Personal Honor. If the enemy card's Force is now zero, gain 2 Honor.

name: Shinjo Hee-Young
flavour: She laughed. "Of course I can make it through enemy lines, my lord."
text:
Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Scout • Loyal
Battle: If Hee-Young is face-up in one of your Provinces: Bring her into play at the current battlefield, ignoring costs if a Recon action has targeted the current battlefield's province this turn.

name: Shinjo Dong-Min
flavour: A true commander bolsters his troops and helps each warrior fight as a legion.
text:
Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Commander
Reaction: After the resolution of an action that Dong-Min performed, if he is opposed: Give a target Personality or Follower in Dong-Min's army +3F.

name: Inugami
text:
Unicorn Clan • Nonhuman • Dog • Cavalry • Guardian • Spirit
Will not attach cards.
Reaction: After the resolution of another player's action that bowed, moved, or destroyed one of your Human Personalities while he was at Inugami's battlefield: Bow a target enemy Follower or Personality without attachments.

name: Ide Kin
flavour: Five hundred more warriors for the fight south, my lord. You will want for nothing as long as I am in charge.
text:
Unicorn Clan • Courtier • Recruiter
Political Open: Bow Kin: Create a 1F Cavalry Follower and attach it to your target Personality.

name: Daigotsu Arima
flavour: We know where the Ebon Daughter is now, and we shall crush her and her pathetic servitors. In the end, Daigotsu shall reign over all.
text:
Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Samurai
After Arima enters play: Lose 5 Honor.
Battle/Open: Straighten your target Personality.

name: Chuda Otsu
flavour:
We must find a way to disrupt the Ebon Daughter's control over her creations, Mishime said.
"I am sure it can be done, my lord," Otsu answered. "My death has given me valuable insight in this regard."
text:
Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Shugenja • Undead
After Otsu enters play: Lose 5 Honor.

name: Daigotsu Shimekiri
flavour: He is powerful, beautiful, merciless.
text:
Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Samurai • Paragon • Dark Art • The Fallen Crane
After Shimekiri enters play: Lose 4 Honor.
Battle: Remove a Fate card in your discard pile from the game: Ranged Attack with strength equal to its Focus Value, and +1 strength if you removed a Dark Virtue.

name: Daigotsu Setsuko - exp
flavour: The stakes are high, but it is such a delightful game.
text:
Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Samurai • Paragon • Experienced • Unique • Dark Perfection
After Setsuko enters play: Lose 4 Honor and put a Dark Virtue from your discard pile into your hand.
Open: Give Setsuko Cavalry, Duelist, or Tactician.

name: Chuda Mishime - exp2
flavour: Die!
text:
Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Shugenja • Daimyo • Experienced 2 • Loyal • Unique
After Mishime enters play: Lose 4 Honor.
Maho Battle: Bow Mishime: Destroy a target enemy Follower or Personality without attachments. If this destroyed a card, create a 2F/2C/0PH Shadowlands • Undead Personality in your current army.

name: Chuda Kanashi
flavour: We are not your allies, but we are enemies of the Destroyer. I could explain, but you will be joining my web shortly, so there is little point.
text:
Spider Clan • Nonhuman • Jorogumo • Shugenja • Artisan • Infiltrator • Origami Master
After Kanashi enters play: Gain 2 Honor.
Limited: Give a target Personality a -1F Web token. If his Force is now 0, bow him.

name: Ao-bozu
flavour: There are things that walk as a man which are not man. Their true countenance is horror incarnate. - The Book of Kuni Mokuna
text:
Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Nonhuman • Oni • Monk • Kensai
After Ao-bozu enters play: Lose 4 Honor, create a +1F Weapon Item, and attach it to Ao-bozu.
Fear Battle: Bow a target enemy Personality with fewer attachments than Ao-bozu.

name: Yogo Rieko - exp
flavour: Although the Kuroiban could find no way to stem the plague, or the zombies it produced, Rieko continued to fight them wherever they appeared.
text:
Scorpion Clan • Air • Shugenja • Ninja • Kuroiban • Experienced • Unique
Battle/Open: Transfer a Poison token from a target Personality to another target Personality.
Battle/Open: Even if Rieko is bowed: Straighten a target Personality.

name: Bayushi Keirei
flavour: He is merciless to his foes. His methods are unconventional and completely effective. - Shosuro Jimen
text:
Scorpion Clan • Ninja • Acrobat
Battle: If Keirei is at the current battlefield: Move him to an adjacent battlefield. You may target and give a -1F Poison token to a Personality at the current battlefield or at Keirei's new battlefield.

name: Bayushi Eiyu
flavour: The madness of the Bitter Lies proved effective even against Kali-ma's forces.
text:
Scorpion Clan • Samurai • Kensai • Bitter Lies
Battle: Show the top card of your Fate deck: Target an enemy Personality. If the card's Focus Value is odd, or lower than the Focus Value of one of Eiyu's Weapons, move the Personality home.

name: Shiba Kotaro
flavour: Where once the Phoenix struggled to divine the nature of the universe, now they have a more focused goal: determining the methods and goals of the Destroyers, and finding ways to combat the plague ravaging the Empire.
text: Phoenix Clan • Samurai • Duelist • Yojimbo

name: Imaishi
flavour: Some Phoenix, eager to avenge the clan's losses during the War of Dark Fire, moved to confront the renewed Yobanjin army.
text:
Phoenix Clan • Air • Shugenja • Summoner
Battle: Bow Imaishi or one of his Spells: Target an enemy unit with a number of cards equal to or lower than the number of cards in Imaishi's unit. Move it home. If it moved, gain 2 Honor.

name: Isawa Ochiai - exp3
text:
Phoenix Clan • Fire • Shugenja • Duelist • Elemental Master • Experienced 3 • Loyal • Unique
Before the resolution of a duel involving your Fire Personality at Ochiai's location: Give each of your focused cards +1 Focus Value.
Battle/Limited: Ochiai challenges another player's target Personality. Ochiai has the first chance to focus in the duel and must use this chance to focus if possible. Bow the duel's loser.

name: Isawa Shun
flavour: It has been six months since Mizuhiko was seen in Phoenix lands. If the worst has occured, we must find him.
text:
Phoenix Clan • Earth • Shugenja • Inquisitor • Magistrate
Battle: Bow a target enemy Personality with Personal Honor lower than Shun's Chi. Gain 2 Honor if the targeted Personality is dishonorable or a Shugenja.

name: Isawa Hachiko
flavour: I tried to divine their intent once, and it almost destroyed me. The nature of the Destroyers is simply too alien. Other methods must be used.
text:
Phoenix Clan • Void • Shugenja • Ishiken
Limited: Look at the top card of your Fate deck. You may put it at the bottom of the deck.

name: Asako Bairei - exp4
flavour: The spirit of water ensures that change is constant, and that there is always something new to learn.
text:
Phoenix Clan • Water • Shugenja • Cavalry • Naval • Elemental Master • Genius • Scribe • Experienced 4 • Unique
Your Water Shugenja in Bairei's army have Naval.
Battle: Show the top card of your Fate Deck. If it is a Spell or Kiho, draw it.

name: Tsuruchi Gidayu - exp
flavour: Of course I volunteered for this duty. Sailing to a mysterious land in search of secrets and adventure? What fool would not?
text:
Mantis Clan • Samurai • Naval • Magistrate • Experienced • Unique • Charitable
Battle/Open: Bow a target attachment.
Battle: Destroy a target enemy card without attachments and that has a lower Gold Cost than Gidayu.

name: Tsuruchi Kuze
flavour: Lord Naizen and his forces prepare to sail to a distant land in accordance with the Empress' wishes, Nobumoto said to his men. "In their absence, we shall scourge the land of these plague zombies from a safe distance, and earn the gratitude of an Empire."
text:
Mantis Clan • Samurai • Perfect
Battle: Ranged 6 Attack.

name: Yoritomo Tahei
flavour: The ruthlessness of a Yoritomo paired with the training of a Hiruma. I find him quite unpleasant. - Moshi Kalani
text:
Mantis Clan • Samurai • Scout • Trap Expert
Battle: Bow Tahei unless a Recon action has targeted this battlefield's province this turn: Tahei leads the enemy into a trap. Bow a target enemy Follower or Personality.

name: Tsuruchi Ogata
flavour: The plague leaves some unable to tend their lands. We shall stand in their place, if we must.
text:
Mantis Clan • Samurai • Magistrate
Limited: Straighten and take control of another player's target non-Unique bowed Holding with Gold Cost lower than Ogata's Chi. The Holding will not be destroyed while you control it. Before your Dynasty Phase begins, return control of it to its owner.

name: Yoritomo Chiako
flavour: To the Mantis, the Divine Empress assigns the task of reaching the Ivory Kingdoms, to determine what there could have given rise to these Destroyers. - Voice of the Empress
text:
Mantis Clan • Samurai • Naval • Commander
Chiako enters play paying 1 less Gold.
You may not assign this unit to, and Chiako will not move into, a defending army.

name: Tsuruchi Ohashi
flavour: The plague has been costly, but confined. Now it spreads like fire throughout the land, with no apparent cause. Some force is behind this. We must find it.
text:
Mantis Clan • Samurai • Naval • Scout
Battle: Bow Ohashi unless a Recon action has targeted this battlefield's province this turn: Move a target unit home.

name: Matsu Mikura - exp
flavour: She is a valiant warrior, if a quiet one. She serves within the Imperial City, and has completed two tours of duty on the Deathless as well. I see in her the qualities that make her lady Kenji great.
text:
Lion Clan • Samurai • Naval • Hero • Experienced • Unique
Battle: Bow Mikura: Ranged 4 Attack.

name: Kitsu Iwao
flavour: Our ancestors are unwavering in their support of this war. One has gone so far as to fight his way across the veil of death to lend aid to his great-great-grandchildren. Never doubt the resolve of the Lion! - Kitsu Kiyoko
text:
Lion Clan • Spirit • Shugenja
Battle/Open: Copy an ability that does not itself copy abilities from your target dead non-Unique Personality to Iwao.

name: Matsu Kenji - exp
flavour:
I have tasted love once, and shall never know its like again. Marriage? It is a duty, like war, but I fear I shall be far greater and the latter than the former. Lion Clan • Samurai • Tactician • Commander • Daimyo • Paragon • Experienced • Loyal • Unique
Battle: Bow a target enemy card. If this bowed a card, gain 1 Honor. Fudo • Unique

name: Heart of Fudo
text:
Fudo • Unique

Reaction: Before one of your Nonhumans with 8 or higher Force is destroyed, destroy this card: Negate the Nonhuman's destruction.

name: Spider Netsuke
flavour: We have ways of identifying ourselves. - Chuda Hiroe
text:
Unique

Non-Shadowlands Personalities may not assign to an army with this unit.
Fear Battle: Bow this card: Move a target enemy Personality home. Until the turn ends, negate his movement.

name: Overwhelming Numbers
flavour: By the Fortunes, is there no end to them? How many must I kill? Stay back, abominations! Back!
text: Battle: If your current army has more units than the current enemy army: The enemy leader chooses and bows one of his unbowed Personalities in his current army.

name: Aoyama
flavour: She is much like Tamago, but utterly without emotion of any kind. I know not who these Fifth Wind are, but if she is their representative, I find them distasteful. - The journals of Utagawa
text:
Ronin • Tactician
Aoyama has +2F while in an army with another Tactician.

name: Ikoma Satoru
flavour:
In times such as these, Korin, we will need your family's knowledge of history more than ever.
"It shall be yours, now and always, Lord Shigetoshi."
text:
Lion Clan • Samurai • Tactician
Battle: Even if Satoru is bowed: Move him to a battlefield with one or more enemy units. Straighten his unit if it moved.

name: Alone with One's Thoughts
flavour: The sake drives the demons away, but they come back. They always come back.
text: Limited: Target a Personality who has fewer Sake tokens than he did at the start of this turn: He drinks to remove his hangover. Give him three +1F Sake tokens.

name: Hida Satoshi
flavour: 'I see no way we can retake the Crab lands with our current resources, Satashi said. 'No matter,' Reiha replied. ' We will continue to fight the enemies of the empire for as long as a single Crab warrior draws breath.'" - The Tale of the Jade Widow
text: Crab Clan • Samurai • Tactician

name: Tennyo
flavour: No one knows why these spirits decided to fight the Destroyers. I, for one, welcome all the help we can get. - Hida Benjiro
text:
Crab Clan • Nonhuman • Tennyo • Cavalry • Scout • Spirit
Battle: Bow Tennyo unless a Recon action has targeted this battlefield's province this turn: Bow a target enemy card without attachments. Destroy the targeted card if it is an attachment.

name: Hida Shimonai
flavour: They are no different from any other Shadowlands creature. Destroyers can die.
text:
Crab Clan • Shadowlands • Berserker • Damned
Battle: Bow a target enemy card with lower Force.

name: Hida Kichiro
flavour: The Crab fought daily to destroy the inexorable army. Despite their greatest efforts, the Crab warriors found themselves retreating from the constant battle.
text:
Crab Clan • Samurai • Commander
Battle: Straighten your target Personality or Follower.

name: Hida Demopen
flavour: How can you put so much value in paintings, fans, and perfumes, when bushi fall to an unending foe?
text:
Crab Clan • Samurai • Hero
Battle: Discard a Heroic Strategy: Ranged 5 Attack.

name: Hida Tenshi
flavour: I am young and I know my weaknesses. I find my own, unique ways to help the war effort.
text:
Crab Clan • Samurai

flavour: If the Emerald Champion is corrupt, there is neither evidence nor testimony to prove it. Should we turn a blind eye to his eveil, then? I say no.
text:
Dragon Clan • Samurai • Duelist • Justicar • Magistrate • Loyal • Scourge of the Scorpion
Limited: Bow Fujimura and target a dishonorable Personality: Fujimura exposes his crimes. His controller loses 2 Honor.

name: Mirumoto Inokuchi
flavour: I am disturbed by the emergence of this Fusami Technique. We are allies today, but the Crane must prepare for tomorrow. - Kakita Korihime
text:
Dragon Clan • Samurai • Duelist • Unbreakable
Battle: Even if Inokuchi is bowed: Straighten him. You may take an additional Battle action, which must be Iaijutsu and which Inokuchi must perform. If you don't, bow him.

name: Mirumoto Houken
flavour: That the Phoenix ended a threat we should have eliminated long ago is a stain that we will not soon forget. To blame them for such a thing, however, would be petty and shameful.
text:
Dragon Clan • Samurai • Kensai • Master of the Blade
Battle/Open: Target a Personality with a Weapon: Straighten his unit.

name: Mirumoto Yozo - exp
flavour: I save your life today only so that I may take it tomorrow, Lion!
text:
Dragon Clan • Samurai • Duelist • Experienced • Unique
Iaijutsu Battle: Target an enemy Follower or Personality without attachments: Destroy it. Remove it from the game if it is a Lion Clan Personality.

name: Tamori Shosei
flavour: His work is absolutely essential to our endeavors. Without him, how much knowledge would have already been lost? - Seppun Tashime
text:
Dragon Clan • Imperial • Earth • Shugenja • Alchemist • Archivist • Jade Hand
Limited: If you control a Temple, bow Shosei or one of your Temple Holdings: Shosei prays to the Fortunes. Gain 1 Honor.

name: Akodo Tezuka
flavour: The aftermath of the zombie march across the Lion lands had repercussions for months after the first threat had been neutralized.
text:
Lion Clan • Samurai • Paragon
Battle/Open: Discard a card and target a Bushido Virtue in your discard pile: Take an additional action to play it for one of its Battle, Limited, or Open actions, as appropriate to the current phase. Remove it from the game after its action ends.

name: Akodo Kobi - exp
text:
Lion Clan • Samurai • Paragon • Tactician • Experienced • Unique
After the resolution of your Tactical action: Give Kobi +1F.
Reaction: After another player's Battle action resolves which destroyed one of your Lion Clan Personalities at the current battlefield: During the next End Phase, if the destroyed Personality is dead, bring him into play, ignoring costs and Honor Requirements.

name: Akodo Ashiko
flavour: Let the Destroyers come! I shall die with them at Shamate Pass!
text:
Lion Clan • Samurai • Deathseeker • Hero
Battle: If Ashiko is face-up in one of your provinces: Bring her into play at the current battlefield, paying all costs, and reducing her Gold cost by 2 if there are more units on the enemy side than on your side.

name: Pride of the Hand
flavour: They seem to have gained a taste for Destroyer flesh, such as it is. - Matsu Benika
text:
Lion Clan • Nonhuman • Lion • Scout • Legendary
Pride of the Hand has +1F while you control a Terrain at its battlefield.

name: Ikoma Ayumu
flavour: If nothing else, this war has proven the Lion were not ready to face this strange, corrupted enemy. We must be more diligent and learn new tactics.
text:
Lion Clan • Samurai • Tactician
Reaction: Even if Ayumu is bowed, after you announce a Tactical action, if he is at the current battlefield: Straighten him.

name: Ikoma Shinohara
flavour: I am an old man, Lord Shigetoshi. I have lived a long life. Would that it had reached its conclusion without seeing such a war.
text:
Lion Clan • Samurai • Commander
Battle: Target a Follower in your hand and one of your Personalities: Attach the Follower to the Personality, paying all costs.

name: Matsu Kaido
flavour: The time for subtlety and brilliance is over. We need brutality and raw power. Now it is my time.
text:
Lion Clan • Samurai • Hero
Kaido has +1F while attacking.
Fear Battle: Target an enemy Personality or Follower: Reduce its Force to 0.

name: Yoritomo Tarao
flavour: There is a profit to be made here. Enough for the clan, and enough for me as well.
text:
Mantis Clan • Samurai • Extortionist • Magistrate • Naval
Open: Pay 2 Gold: Choose a player. He targets one of his unbowed Personalities or Holdings or a card in his hand. If the targeted card is in his hand, discard it. Otherwise, bow it.

name: En'you
flavour: The first sailors who saw him were accused of being too far in their cups, but after the third report, even the most cynical started keeping an eye out for him.
text:
Mantis Clan • Nonhuman • Shojo • Prophet
As an additional cost of En'you entering play, either remove a card in your hand from the game or destroy one of your Sake tokens.

name: Moshi Umiko
flavour: Many of the Mantis are away but the Destroyers should not think that we cannot defend ourselves.
text:
Mantis Clan • Thunder • Shugenja • Naval • Storm Rider
Umiko has +2F while she has a Spell.
Reaction: After a Ranged Attack is targeted: Give the Ranged Attack +2 or -2 strength.

name: Tsuruchi Yashiro
flavour: They have both wronged us, but a brother from a different clan is still a brother.
text:
Mantis Clan • Samurai • Scout
Enters play paying 2 less Gold if you are a Lion Clan or Scorpion Clan player.
Battle: Bow Yashiro unless you have Reconnaissance: Ranged 4 Attack.

name: Yoritomo Zinan
flavour: We are far from Rokugan, yet still we fight Kali-ma. Our cause is just.
text:
Mantis Clan • Samurai • Commander • Naval
Battle: Target an attachment: Put it in its owner's hand.

name: Yoritomo Sachina - exp
text:
Mantis Clan • Courtier • Seductress • Experienced • Loyal • Unique
Sachina's base ability will not be copied.
Political Limited: Once per game, target a Personality, pay Gold equal to his unit's total Gold Cost plus four, and bow Sachina: Take control of him. After the next time this game Sachina leaves play, give control of him to his owner.

name: Yoritomo Singh - exp2
flavour: Duty bade me leave, and duty brought me back.
text:
Mantis Clan • Courtier • Samurai • Ambassador • Magistrate • Naval • Experienced 2 • Loyal • Unique
Reaction: When paying an action's Gold cost: Produce 3 Gold.
Battle: Target an enemy card without attachments and pay Gold equal to its Gold Cost: Destroy it.

name: Asako Heiwa
flavour: The Dark Fire has waned and the people of the Phoenix can rest again. It is my responsibility to soothe our wounds. It is the Shiba's to rejoin the southern front.
text:
Phoenix Clan • Earth • Monk • Henshin
Battle/Open: Target another Personality or a Follower: Give it a Force bonus or penalty equal to Heiwa's Chi.

name: Asako Izuna
flavour: Yes, I think his absence would be most convenient.
text:
Phoenix Clan • Air • Shugenja • Inquisitor • Magistrate • Villain
Reaction: After Izuna enters play, target another player's Personality with Personal Honor lower than or equal to Izuna's Chi: She coerces testimony of a family's secret. Dishonor the targeted Personality and permanently give him Kolat, Ninja, or Shadowlands.

name: Isawa Sakonoko
flavour: With the threat of the Army of Dark Fire ended the Phoenix began the long process of healing their wounds.
text:
Phoenix Clan • Water • Shugenja • Inquisitor • Magistrate • Unique
Reaction: After another player's action targets one of your other Personalities at Sakonoko's location, bow Sakonoko or one of his Spells: Negate the destruction of the Personality from the action's effects.

name: Isawa Kaname
flavour: There are some threats that no blade can slay and no armor can ward. The kami and I stand against them.
text:
Phoenix Clan • Fire • Shugenja • Yojimbo
Reaction: After a Ranged Attack is targeted: Give the Ranged Attack +2 strength.
Battle: Any number of times per turn: Ranged 1 Attack.

name: Shiba Jouta - exp
flavour: He charges into the heart of battle against the Destroyers with no fear. His example inspires greatness. - Shiba Danjuro
text:
Phoenix Clan • Samurai • Yojimbo • Experienced • Unique
Battle: Even if Jouta is dead, choose your performing Shugenja, who may be at any location unless Jouta is dead: Ranged 5 Attack.

name: Shiba Ryuba
flavour: Send me against the Destroyers! The creatures of the Dark Oracle posed no threat. Maybe these shall.
text:
Phoenix Clan • Samurai • Duelist • Yojimbo
Battle: Target your Personality: Move him home. If he moved, straighten him.

name: Kunji
flavour: It came to fight the Dark Fire. Will it stay with its purifying light, or will it leave no that the threat has passed? - Shiba Tsukimi
text:
Phoenix Clan • Nonhuman • Fenghuang • Shugenja • Cavalry
Battle/Open: Target a Personality: Give him +2F.

name: Bayushi Shibata
flavour: I will exploit every resource, my lady. Every fool and sinner I have known in twenty years of service shall pay the price for their actions, and all to our benefit.
text:
Scorpion Clan • Courtier • Resourceful
Your provinces have +1 strength while another player controls a dishonorable Personality.

name: Bayushi Ebara
flavour: Fighting alongside Crab and Lion, all shedding blood for the defense of my home... I hardly know what to think of it.
text:
Scorpion Clan • Samurai • Bitter Lies • Kensai
Battle/Open: Target a Weapon in your hand: Attach it to Ebara, paying all costs: Draw a card.

name: Soshi Komiko
flavour: We have reason to believe that Noritoshi has abandoned all pretense, my lord. He is on his way here, to the Imperial City.
text:
Scorpion Clan • Courtier • Junshin • Magistrate • Iron Flower
Political Battle: Target a Personality with Personal Honor lower than or equal to Komiko's Chi: Bow the Personality. If he is dishonorable, his controller loses 2 Honor.

name: Shosuro Tsuji
flavour: The Destroyers are iron, but their leaders, their officers, are living creatures. And the living can be killed. Do this, and teach them what it means to cross the Scorpion. - Bayushi Miyako
text:
Scorpion Clan • Ninja • Assassin
Battle: Target an enemy card: Bow it.

name: Bayushi Suwabe
flavour: Will it be me that kills you? My brother? Cousin? Neighbor? All that matters is that the Scorpion will end you.
text:
Scorpion Clan • Samurai • Paragon • Yojimbo • Loyal
Battle/Open: Choose your performing Courtier at any location: Give Suwabe a Force bonus equal to the Courtier's Chi.

name: Shosuro Toson - exp2
flavour: At times, a Shosuro lord must bloody his blade.
text:
Scorpion Clan • Daimyo • Ninja • Experienced 2 • Loyal • Unique
Reaction: After engaging at Toson's battlefield: Discard a card from the current battlefield's province. If this discarded a Personality, you have the first opportunity to take a Battle action in this battle, which must be performed by Toson.

name: Wrathful Dead
flavour: The destruction of our lands has unleashed the wrath of the spirits. Our dead visit their anger upon the Destroyers, and I celebrate them for it. - Soshi Yukimi
text:
Scorpion Clan • Nonhuman • Goryo • Cavalry • Spirit
Battle: Target a card without attachments in a unit led by a dishonorable Personality: Destroy the targeted card.

name: Chuda Kiuchi
flavour:
Fingers, an eye, some blood and thread,
A loving toy made from the dead!
text:
Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Shugenja • Artisan • Vicious • Worker of Flesh
After Kiuchi enters play: Lose 1 Honor.
Open: Choose your performing Personality and your performing Nonhuman or Undead Personality: Set each Personality's Force equal to the higher base Force of the two.

name: Daigotsu Miki
flavour: The Destroyers' goddess prepares for the final act of this farce. We must be ready to answer her.
text:
Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Samurai • Conqueror • Paragon • Undead • Dark Fist of Iron
After Miki enters play: Lose 1 Honor.
After your Events Phase: You may remove a Dark Virtue in your hand or discard pile from the game. If you did not remove one, destroy Miki.

name: Daigotsu Yajinden - exp3
flavour: Hmm, Anguish. Yes, it needs more anguish.
text:
Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Shugenja • Artisan • Bloodspeaker • Khadi • Experienced 3 • Loyal • Unique
After Yajinden enters play: Lose 4 Honor.
Limited: Target a dead Personality: Yajinden raises him from the dead. Bring him into play (under your control) ignoring costs and Honor Requirements. Remove him from the game when the turn ends.

name: Goju Sawaki
flavour: The Destroyers are wholly within the Empire, he whispered. "The clans have taken their toll upon the ranks."
text:
Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Ninja • Immortal
After Sawaki enters play: Lose 2 Honor.
Reaction: After another player's Battle action targets Sawaki, destroy him: Create two 1F/1C/0PH Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Ninja Personalities at the current battlefield.

name: Daigotsu Bukaro
flavour: Do nothing yet. Wait for the whelps that carry the Tao. We act only when they have made their choice.
text:
Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Samurai • Commander • Conqueror
After Bukaro enters play: Lose 1 Honor.
Limited: Pay 2 Gold and target a Personality: Create a 1F Follower and attach it to the Personality.

name: Taishuu - exp
flavour: Shall I tell you what Togashi saw before he left?
text:
Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Courtier • Samurai • Paragon • Experienced Mirumoto Taishuu • Loyal • Unique • Ambassador to the Empire
Other player's maximum hand sizes are reduced by 1.
Reaction: After another player's Political action targets one of your Personalities: Negate its effects.

name: Omigawa
flavour: Do you see your brothers in my face, samurai? When the Destroyers fall, you are next!
text:
Spider Clan • Monk • Kensai • Face of Ghosts • Master Sensei
Battle: Target an enemy Personality with lower Force or without attached Weapons: Omigawa knocks him aside. Move the targeted card home. Bow him if he moved and Omigawa has a Weapon.

name: Iuchi Kota - exp
flavour: I relish the chance to work with the Crab again.
text:
Unicorn Clan • Water • Shugenja • Cavalry • Experienced • Unique
Kota has +2F while he has a Spell.
Reaction: After an action targets one of your Personalities at Kota's battlefield: Negate the Personality's movement from the action's effects.

name: Iuchi Yupadi
flavour: She was born an Utaku, but her training with the Iuchi proved her of such exceptional ability that she was wed into the daimyo's extended family and took their name. - Moto Chen
text:
Unicorn Clan • Water • Shugenja • Cavalry • Ghost Guard
Limited: Bow Yupadi or one of her Spells, and target a Personality: Give him Naval.

name: Shinjo Byung
flavour: If we are to give our lives to give Katamari and Benjiro time to defeat the enemy, then we will visit the Shi-Tien Yen-Wang with pride.
text: Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Tactician

name: Moto Hailung
flavour: Never have I felt such exhaustion, friend Hiruma. But if you, whose home is lost, will fight on, then I will fight beside you.
text:
Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Commander
Battle: Target a Follower in your hand: Attach it to Hailung, paying all costs and paying 4 less Gold if he is defending or if you are a Crab Clan player.

name: Shinjo Dak-ho
flavour: I have studied Akodo's Leadership, but the Lion commanders have found new ways to wage war.
text:
Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Scout
Battle: Create a 2F/2C/2PH Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Scout Personality at this battlefield. Remove him from the game after this battle ends.

name: Utaku Eun-ju
flavour: None will dare question our loyalty again. We stand with Rokugan, now and forever!
text:
Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Battle Maiden • Cavalry • Paragon
Battle: Target an enemy Personality with lower Personal Honor: Bow him. Gain 2 Honor.

name: Utaku Tairu - exp
flavour: I have been honored to serve with the Amethyst Champion, but duty first brings me to war. With her blessing I fight in her name.
text:
Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Tactician • Experienced • Unique • Advisor to the Amethyst Champion
Reaction: After a Personality assigns or moves, if he is now opposing Tairu: Draw a card.

name: The Great Death
flavour: We call ourselves masters of the sea. But we are merely deceiving ourselves. - Yoritomo Sunagawa
text:
Shadowlands • Nonhuman • Bake-kujira • Water • Naval • Undead
After The Great Death enters play: Create three 1F Shadowlands • Nonhuman • Raptor • Cavalry • Undead Followers, attach them to it, and lose 6 Honor.

name: The Red Hunger
flavour: The loss of the Ivory Kingdoms' warriors means that many horrors they held in check now wander the world. - Yoritomo Singh
text:
Nonhuman • Bashe
Battle: Target one or two attachments, or a Personality without attachments, with a total Force lower than The Red Hunger's Force: He swallows them whole. Destroy the targeted cards.

name: Stone-Hewed Shrine
flavour: Chosai left little unharmed.
text:
Mountain • Temple
Defending Earth Personalities have +1F while at this province's battlefield.
Battle: Even if you control no units at the current battlefield, bow your performing Earth Personality at any location: Give the current battlefield's province +3 strength.

name: Temple of the Seven Fortunes
flavour: Rokugan must stand together to survive. How often must we learn this simple lesson? - Asako Barei
text:
Temple • Singular
Open: If it is not your turn, choose your two performing unbowed Personalities with Clan alignments that do not share a Clan alignment, and bow one of them: Gain 1 Honor. Give your provinces +2 strength.

name: Ashigaru Elite
flavour: The samurai believe they are the strength of the Empire. Lucky for them, we are willing to let them believe that. - Sachika
text:
Ashigaru • Elite • Unique
Battle: Any number of times per turn, bow one of your Farms: Give +1F to each of your Ashigaru Personalities and Followers at the current battlefield.

name: Ashigaru Recruits
flavour: If they do not fight, they will die. If they fight they will likely die. Better a slim chance than none. - Akodo Kuma
text:
Ashigaru
Reaction: After this card enters play from your hand, target your Personality: Create a 0F Ashigaru Follower and attach it to him.

name: Horse Archers
flavour: I have ridden with them and against them. Let the Destroyers taste their arrows this day. - Akodo Masao
text:
Cavalry
Battle: Ranged 4 Attack.

name: Hida Defenders
flavour: With their lands occupied, all must do their duty, no matter what their training.
text: Reaction: After the resolution of your action that bowed, destroyed, or moved a Personality who has opposed this card at the current battlefield: Gain 2 Honor.

name: Brothers of Goemon
flavour: We stand with the samurai of Rokugan, as our patron would have done.
text: Reaction: After another player's action targets a card in this unit, if you control any Rings: Negate the card's bowing from the action's effects.

name: The Crimson Mark
flavour: Even the Scorpion dislike them, but they serve their lords well.
text:
Ninja
As a Focus Effect: You may destroy an attachment on a Personality involved in this duel.
Battle: Destroy this card and target an enemy card without attachments: Destroy it.

name: Genji's Students
flavour: Slowly, the lessons of the Kaiu spread.
text:
Siege
Battle/Open: Bow this card and target a province: Give it +3 or -3 strength.
Battle: Bow this card: Ranged 3 Attack with +1 strength for each other Follower in this unit.

name: Vigilant Riders
flavour: With Rokugan itself threatened, all who could fight answered the call.
text:
Cavalry
After this card bows: Straighten it.
Reaction: After another player's action targets a card in this unit: Negate this card's destruction from the action's effects.

name: Rumormonger
flavour: I heard from a courtier very close to their delegation that a certain samurai may not be as she seems...
text: Political Open: Bow this card and target a Personality controlled by a player who controls a dishonorable Personality: Give the targeted card a Force penalty equal to his base Personal Honor.

name: A Simple Yari
flavour: Sometimes, nothing else is needed. - Shiba Jouta
text:
Weapon
As a Focus Effect: After this duel ends, bow its winner.
Reaction: After one of your Personalities enters play: Attach this card to him, paying all costs.

name: Crimson Shadow Armor
flavour: They say that they hate us, that we disgrace them, that they would wipe us out. But in their hearts, they fear us. As they should. - Bayushi Muhito
text:
Armor
Fear Battle: Target an enemy Follower: Bow it.

name: Hunger
flavour: Ahh, Togashi Nyoko. A woman after my own heart, truly. - Daigotsu Yajinden
text:
Shadowlands • Weapon • Unique
You must declare an attack each turn and assign this Personality to attack if possible.
Reaction: After an action targets this Personality: Negate this Personality's movement from the action's effects.

name: Tsubute
flavour: Such a simple thing can be so useful in the hands of the properly trained. - Shosuro Toson
text:
Ninja • Weapon
Will only attach to a Ninja.
Battle: Choose your performing Ninja, and destroy this card or discard it from your hand: Ranged 3 Attack.

name: Drawing on the Mountain
flavour: This castle may fall, my friend Shiba, but it will not fall today!
text:
Earth
While this Shugenja is Earth, your provinces have +1 strength.
Battle/Open: Bow this Shugenja, destroy this card, and target a bowed Personality: Negate his next straightening this game.

name: Seek the Stain
flavour: I feel them! So... so befouled!
text:
Void
You may attach this card from your discard pile to your Void Shugenja.
Open: Bow this card and target another player's Personality: You find out his dark secret. Give him Kolat, Ninja, or Shadowlands.

name: Erosion
flavour: The ridge on which they stand will not be a problem in just a moment, my lord.
text:
Water
While this Shugenja is Water, other players' provinces have -1 strength.
Reaction: After the resolution of an action that moved a Personality to the current battlefield: Give him -4F.

name: Ember's Final Fire
flavour: The priest clutched his bloodied stomach. "It is too late for me," he rasped. "But I will not enter the next world alone. Run while you can. I will end this."
text:
Fire
While this Shugenja is Fire, he has +1F.
Battle: Bow this card and target an enemy attachment: Destroy it.

name: Death, Defeated
flavour: Do you still judge me, samurai?
text:
Maho
This Shugenja has +2F and Shadowlands.
Battle: Remove a target dead Personality in any player's discard pile from the game: Create a 2F/2C/0PH Shadowlands • Undead Personality at the current battlefield. Remove him from the game after this battle's resolution. Lose 2 Honor.

name: The Tapestry Perceived
flavour: The future is never clear, but now... now it is almost completely obscured. I fear its meaning. - Isawa Kimi
text:
Void
While this Shugenja is Void, your maximum hand size is increased by 1.
Limited: Bow this card: Look at the top card of any Fate deck. You may destroy this card; if you do, discard the card you looked at.

name: A Dragon's Favor
flavour: The power our shugenja now possess is wondrous and terrible, but we must never become reliant upon it. If it were revoked, I would not have my clan founder in its absence. - Yoritomo Naizen
text:
Thunder
While this Shugenja is Thunder, he has +1C.
Battle: Bow this card: Ranged Attack with strength equal to this Shugenja's Chi.

name: Of One Instant
flavour: A duelist learns the limits of his mind and body, so that he may bypass them for one perfect moment.
text:
Iaijutsu
As a Focus Effect: Give your Personality in this duel Tactician.
Battle/Open: Choose your performing Duelist: Give him a Force bonus equal to his own base Chi.

name: Anger Management
flavour: Finally. Something I can utterly destroy for a change.
text:
Heroic
Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Hero and target an enemy card: If it has no attachments, and is bowed or Nonhuman, destroy it. Bow it.

name: The World Disappears
flavour: It is more important than ever, now, to touch the fundamentals of the world.
text:
Void • Kiho
Open: Bow your performing Monk unless his is Void: He meditates. Put a Kiho Strategy in your discard pile into your hand.

name: Destructive Priorities
flavour: All my plans and machinations are nothing without you.
text:
Kata • Political
You have the ability, "Political Reaction: Before you gain Honor during your turn, bow your performing Courtier: Negate the gain. Choose a player. He loses 2 Honor."
Limited: Put this card into play. Discard all your other Katas.

name: Firm Censure
flavour: You told a guest your true feelings? You ignorant fool! Control yourself!
text: Open: Choose your performing Samurai and target another player's Personality or Follower: Negate the effects of the next action performed by the targeted card (this turn). Bow it if it has no attachments and is not a Samurai.

name: A Gentle Word
flavour: In Rokugan, testimony of an honorable man is stronger than a mountain of evidence. A single sentence from a respected samurai can undo months of suspicion.
text: Limited: Choose your performing Magistrate and target a dishonorable Personality: Rehonor him. Gain 2 Honor.

name: Spirit of the Warrior
flavour: At the heart of the battle, warriors must bear the weight of command or crack under the pressure. Those who succeed often prove the best leaders of all.
text: Limited: Choose your performing unbowed Personality: If he is a Commander, permanently give him the ability, "Battle: Bow one of this Personality's performing Followers and target an enemy card without attachments: Destroy it." Otherwise, permanently give him Commander.

name: The Killing Grounds
flavour: This land shall see death. Theirs or ours.
text:
Terrain
After the first time, while this card remains in play, that a player passes instead of announcing a Battle action: He chooses and destroys one of his Personalities at the current battlefield.
Battle: Put this card into play at the current battlefield.

name: Dismissing the Cur
flavour: You disgrace the name you bear and the Empire you serve. Get out of my sight before my actions turns ungracious.
text:
Political
Battle: Bow your performing Courtier at any location and target an enemy Personality with equal or lower Personal Honor: Move him home. Destroy him if he has no attachments. Gain 2 Honor.

name: Disrupting Communication
flavour: By sheer weight of numbers, the Destroyers continue onward, Hiruma Ikuya said, "but out vigilance will keep them back as long as we can."
text: Battle: Bow your performing Scout and target an enemy card: Bow it. The enemy leader discards a card of his choice, or a random card if you have Reconnaissance.

name: Necessary Evil
flavour: We must ensure that the Phoenix know neither too much, nor too little. Determine which is the case and we will deal with it. - Shosuro Toson
text: Open: If you control a Personality, target a Personality and pay Gold equal to the number of Personalities you control, or 4, whichever is higher: The targeted Personality may not assign to battlefields.

name: Ascending the Ranks
flavour: I am greatful for all that you have taught me. I am sure you are honored to be the first to discover just how much I have learned.
text: Battle/Open: Choose your performing Paragon, bow him unless this is the Attack Phase, and target a Personality with lower Force: Bow him. Lose 3 Honor.

name: Amazing Feat
flavour: The greatest masters are forgotten. Their legacies are immortalized in their stead. - Kakita Yasunori
text: Limited: Bow your performing Artisan Personality and target a non-Unique Personality: Create a Personality with the same base Force, Chi, Personal Honor and keywords as the targeted Personality, who permanently copies all his base abilities except those that copy abilities. Remove the created Personality from the game when your next turn begins.

name: Fear Me!
flavour: Do you see? Inokuchi shouted. "Do you see what you face?"
text:
Fear • Iaijutsu
Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Duelist and target an enemy Personality with equal or lower Chi: Move him home. If he moved, choose a player, who either gains or loses 2 Honor.

name: Brothers in Battle
flavour: Even among former enemies, the bonds forged on the battlefield cannot easily be broken.
text:
Bushido Virtue • Duty
