Water
Battle: If this Shugenja is unbowed, target an enemy Personality, who must be attacking unless this Shugenja is Water, and bow this card: Move the Personality home. Bow all cards in his unit if he moved.

name: Allegations
flavour: Do not overstep, Isawa-san
text:
Political
Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Magistrate and target an enemy Personality with lower Personal Honor than your Magistrate's Chi: Dishonor the Personality. His controller chooses whether to bow him or move him home.

name: Black and White
flavour: The line between right and wrong is hard to see in battle.
text:
Bushido Virtue • Dark Virtue
Battle: Bow your performing Paragon and target an enemy card without attachments: Destroy it. Gain 1 Honor if your Paragon has 3 or more Personal Honor; otherwise, lose 3 Honor.

name: Changing Paths
text:
Kiho
Battle/Open: Choose your performing unbowed Monk or Shugenja: Name a Ring. The next time this turn you trigger its base trait that would put it into play from your hand, search your discard pile, then Fate deck, for that Ring. Show it. Put it into your hand. (Shuffle your Fatre deck; you then may play the Ring.)

name: Charge
flavour: You have one chance and one chance only, Scorpion. Recant your dishonor and admit what you have done. Perhaps then the Lion will have mercy upon your diseased souls.
text: Battle: Target an attacking Personality: Give him +2F, or +3F if he is Lion Clan (until the turn ends).

name: Chasing Osano-Wo
flavour: The Phoenix are not alone in their ability to command the elements, but they are without question the most skilled.
text:
Thunder • Kiho
Battle: Bow your performing Monk or Shugenja at any location and target a Personality: Give him a Force bonus equal to the Force of the performer plus the Personality's own Personal Honor (until the turn ends).

name: Cold Hands, Stone Heart
flavour: Let us discuss philosophy, Isawa-san.
text:
Kiho
Battle: Choose your performing Monk without Weapons and target an enemy Personality with equal or lower Chi: Remove an ability from the Personality (until the turn ends). Give your Monk +2F (until the turn ends). Draw a card. You may take an additional Battle action.

name: Courtesy
flavour: An essential precept of the code of Bushido, and yet one that so many clans completely ignore. - Togashi Gato
text:
Bushido Virtue
Battle: Choose your performing unbowed honorable Samurai Personality and target an enemy Personality: Move both Personalities home. Each of their controllers gains Honor equal to the Personal Honor of the other Personality.

name: Dance of the Void
text:
Void • Kata
Limited: Put this card into play in your home. Discard any other Kata cards you control. While this card remains in play, your Monks without Weapons have +1C and you have the ability, "Battle: If this action is taken as an additional action, choose your performing Monk: Negate his next bowing or destruction from a card's effect this turn."

name: Fist and Blade
flavour: Flesh against steel. Which shall prove stronger?
text: Battle: Bow your performing Monk and target an enemy Personality with lower Chi: His controller may transfer any of that Personality's attachments to one other Personality of his choice in the same army. Destroy the enemy Personality.

name: From Every Side
flavour: The most interesting of scenarios. - Akodo Shigetoshi
text:
Battle: Increase the current battlefield's province's strength by twice the number of units on the defending side (until the turn ends).
Battle: Reduce the current battlefield's province's strength by the number of units on the attacking side (until the turn ends).

name: Glorious Path to Victory
flavour: Follow me, brothers! Today we may die, or claim victory! Either way, our tale lives forever!
text:
Bushido Virtue
Battle: Rehonor all Personalities at this battlefield. You may target and give your opposed Samurai Personality a Force bonus equal to his Personal Honor (until the turn ends). Gain 2 Honor.

name: Magistrate's Accusation
flavour: The Dragon are an unpredictable ally at best. Perhaps a distraction? - Bayushi Maemi
text: Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Magistrate Personality and target an enemy Personality with lower Personal Honor than your Magistrate's Chi: Bow the Personality. His controller loses 2 Honor.

name: Paths of Honor & Glory
flavour: Two paths exist, one light and one dark. The light path has ever been the greater, but the dark path gains new adherents every day. - Asahina Hira
text:
Bushido Virtue • Dark Virtue
Open: Target a Samurai: Straighten him.
Battle: Target a Samurai without attachments: Bow him.

name: Restoring Order
flavour: Remind them of the Empress's law. - Shosuro Jimen
text:
Political
Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Magistrate Personality and target an enemy Personality with Personal Honor lower than your Magistrate's Chi: Move the Personality home. Bow him if he moved. Destroy him if he is dishonorable.

name: Seeking the Guilty
text:
Political
Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Magistrate and target an enemy Personality with lower Personal Honor than your Magistrate's Chi: Move the Personality home. His controller loses Honor equal to the number of dishonorable Personalities he controls or 3, whichever is lower.

name: Settling the Homeless
flavour: A dispute between two clans, with two more involved in a misguided attempt to mediate, and how many suffer as a result? - Shinjo Dun
text: Battle: Even if you control no units at the current battlefield, target a Personality without Followers: Move him home.

name: Stagnation
flavour: Sometimes, the mind is blocked and the soul is emptied. Do not fear. Only after the winter can again come the spring. - Naka Kuro
text:
Kiho
Battle/Open: Choose your performing unbowed Monk or Shugenja and target a Personality: Remove his base abilities (until the turn ends).

name: Unpredictable Strategy
flavour: The ones you are looking for are not here, Scorpion. I thought we might resolve this matter ourselves.
text: Battle: Target a unit, and another unit controlled by the same player at any other location: Switch the two units' locations. Straighten all cards in them if they moved.

name: Unstoppable Power
flavour: Many fear the power of the Phoenix, as they should. But they need not fear a loss of control. Those days are long gone. - Isawa Ochiai, the Master of Fire
text: Battle: Target an enemy card: Give it a Force penalty equal to the number of different element keywords (Air, Earth, Fire, Void, and Water) in your army (until the turn ends). Gain Honor equal to the amount of Force it lost. You may take an additional Battle action.

name: Viper Tattoo
flavour: Tattoos inked with the blood of the divine are capable of wondrous things. Wondrous, and occaisionally horrible. - Moshi Kamiya
text:
Tattoo
Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Tattooed Personality, and target an enemy card without attachments and with equal or lower Force: The tattoo comes alive. Give your Personality +2F (until the turn ends). Bow the enemy card.

name: Tetsu Kama Mura
flavour: Iron Mountain Village breeds souls of iron. - Togashi Kanmu
text:
Before you draw a card: You may draw it from the bottom of your deck.
Limited: Look at the top card of your Fate deck. You may put it on the bottom of your deck.

name: Venerable Plains of the Ikoma
flavour: Its honor will remain unblemished. - Matsu Yosa
text: Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Personality, target an enemy Personality with lower Personal Honor, and discard a card: Bow the enemy Personality. Gain 2 Honor if you discarded a Bushido Virtue.

name: City of Tears
flavour: We weep for those who die without purpose. - Isawa Kyoko
text:
Equipping Spells is a Battle/Open action for you.
After the resolution of an Equip Battle action you took: You may take an additional Battle action from a Spell it attached.

name: Seven Stings Keep
flavour: True strength is doing what must be done, no matter the consequences. - Soshi Tabito
text: Limited: A target player loses 2 Honor for each of his provinces that have been destroyed this game.

name: Disreputable House
flavour: It is a simple matter to disgrace a single samurai, regardless of what he has actually done. An entire clan? That may prove more difficult. - Bayushi Maemi
text:
Geisha House
Bow this card: Produce 2 Gold.
Political Open: Bow this card: Choose another player. He loses 2 Honor.

name: Fortuitous Alliance
flavour: Thank you, friends. Always good to see you!
text: Battle: Look at the top 4 cards of your Fate deck. You may rearrange them. Draw a card. If there are any allying units on your side at the current battlefield (including your own if you are an ally)

name: Hiruma Nikaru
flavour: All of Fubatsu's students were dead and the Sensei was missing. The Crab swore that blood would flow for this, whether that blood be red or not.
text:
Crab Clan • Berserker
Battle: Target an enemy Personality: Bow him. He may not perform actions.

name: Yasuki Daiki
flavour: There are many ways to win a war.
text:
Crab Clan • Courtier • Merchant
Political Open: Target another player's Personality: His controller chooses to either pay 4 Gold, lose 2 Honor, or do neither. If he did not pay 4 Gold or lose 2 Honor, the Personality may not be assigned, and will not move, into attacking armies.

name: Asahina Shigemitsu
flavour: These are troubling signs, and our clan is still recovering from the troubles of the past. We must be vigilant so that our rebuilding is not jeopardized.
text:
Crane Clan • Air • Shugenja
Open: Bow Shigemitsu or one of his Spells: Give each of your provinces +1 strength. If it is not your turn, before it ends, if none of your provinces were destroyed this turn, gain 1 Honor.

name: Doji Rengetsu
flavour: The new Imperial Governor must be someone of vision and boldness. Great things can come from these new lands, and we must not be timid in grasping them.
text:
Crane Clan • Courtier • Artisan
Political Open: Discard the Imperial Favor and target a Personality or Holding: Choose one of its abilities; it may not be used.

name: Kitsuki Nubane
flavour: The Kitsuki family interpreted their initial failure to explain the disappearance of Mirumoto Mareshi as a failure of their methods. Throughout the Empire, Kitsuki-trained magistrates attempted to find answers to the mystery.
text:
Dragon Clan • Courtier • Duelist • Magistrate
Open: Target an attachment: Bow it.

name: Tamori Kazushige
flavour: You seek to cut the earth with a blade?
text:
Dragon Clan • Earth • Shugenja
Kazushige has +2F while defending.
Open: If it is another player's turn, target one of his Personalities: Before this phase ends, straighten him. Before this turn ends, if the Personality did not assign to attack this turn, gain 2 Honor.

name: Kitsu Kagako
flavour: I implore aid, grandmother, though I am unworthy.
text:
Lion Clan • Water • Shugenja
Reaction: After Kagako enters play: She summons an ancestor. Create a 2F/2C/3PH Lion Clan • Samurai • Ancestor • Spirit Personality. Gain 1 Honor.

name: Ikoma Tsukasa
flavour: No, I do not ride a horse. You assumed I would, and that is why I am victorious and you lay dying.
text:
Lion Clan • Samurai • Scout
Battle: Target a card in a unit; the card must have no attachments unless you control a Terrain: Bow or straighten the card.

name: Cursed Relic
flavour: Some secrets of the kingdom are best left forgotten. - Yoritomo Singh
text:
Cursed • Weapon
Battle: Any number of times per turn, give this Personality -1C: Ranged 3 Attack.
Battle: Bow this card, give this Personality -1C, and target an enemy card without attachments: Remove it from the game.

name: Returning Home
flavour: For too long our people have slept while the upstart humans have carved out their empire from our lands. No more! We shall gather our people and rekindle their greatness, and then we shall wipe our lands clean of these invaders. - The Shahismael
text: Reaction: After a battle ends in which you destroyed a province as the Attacker: Create a Holding with the trait "Bow this card: Produce 3 Gold" (it enters play bowed). Draw a card.

name: Never Beyond My Reach
flavour: Flee the region, flee the province, flee the entire Empire. You will never escape my vengeance.
text: Battle: Even if you control no units at the current battlefield, choose your performing unbowed Kensai, who may be at an adjacent battlefield to the current one if he has a Weapon attached: Ranged 6 Attack (against a target at the current battlefield).

name: Wanted for Questioning
flavour: Murder? Arson? I will not have it! Bring me the scum from which one might typically expect such an act.
text: Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Magistrate and target an enemy Personality: Your Magistrate takes him into custody. If he is dishonorable, destroy his attachments. Move him home.

name: Yotsu Ueda
flavour: The devastated lands are filled with survivors who desperately need assistance. Who is bold enough to accompany me behind the Destroyer lines?
text:
Samurai • Commander • Gunso • Kensai
Battle: Target an enemy Follower or Personality without Followers with Force equal to or lower than 4: Destroy it.

name: Yotsu Ueda's Chosen
flavour: We will join you, gunso. To abandon those in need would be an unforgiveable crime.
text:
Attaches to Yotsu Ueda paying 2 less Gold.
Battle: Target an attachment: Bow or straighten it.

name: Natsu-Togumara's Guidance
text:
Fortune • Unique
After this card enters play: You may choose a Personality. While this card remains in play, battle resolution does not bow cards in that Personality's unit.
Battle: If there are any enemy units at the current battlefield, choose your performing Personality and discard this card: Move him to the current battlefield. If he moved, straighten his unit.

name: Open Recruitment
flavour: The stresses of the Destroyer War drove many clans to offer fealty to ronin, something they had never before done.
text:
Unique
Until your Events Phase two turns from now begins, after each time an unaligned Human Personality turns face-up in one of your provinces, permanently give him your Clan alignment. He has sworn fealty to you.

name: All That Will Be Lost
flavour: My predecessors and I have struggled against the Empire for more than one thousand years. Always seeking its destruction or its subjugation. Now that moment seems at hand and I find myself... remorseful. I want only respect for Fu Leng. If all of Rokugan is dead, who will exalt his name? - Daigotsu
text: You may choose and bow a Personality.

name: Twisted Fate
flavour: In this time of crisis, many have united to serve the Empire. Others seek to advance their own fortunes. In their struggles, it is difficult to distinguish the former from the latter. - Matsu Kenji
text:
Unique
Until your Events Phase three turns from now begins, there is an additional Action Phase each turn which occurs between the Dynasty and End Phases.

name: Shrine to the Heavens
flavour: It can be easy to forget the simple things during war, but some simple things should never be forgotten.
text:
Temple
Bow this card: Produce 2 Gold.
After one of your Celestials is revealed in a province: You may choose one of your Celestials in play. If you do, it is not discarded because of the other Celestial entering play.

name: Tashiki
flavour: Yes, yes, this is perfect! The location is excellent! The samurai will need parangu to cut these plants, and larger clay bottles for the heat. I will be a wealthy man!
text:
Merchant • Settler
Open: Bow Tashiki and target a Market or Port Holding: Straighten it.

name: Masaya
flavour: Whatever you require, my lord. But these are desperate times, and many have need of my talents.
text:
Ronin • Samurai
Open: If Masaya is face-up in one of your provinces: Bring him into play, paying all costs and paying 2 less Gold. Before the turn ends, put him on top of your Dynasty deck.

name: Jahan
flavour: I have lost everything except my life, which has no value. If you wish my help, it is yours, but know the value of that which you desire.
text:
Gaijin • Kshatriya • Scout
While Jahan is at the current battlefield, other players may not play Terrains.

name: Kamalakar
flavour: I will not see my father's lands in chaos. If you bring order, then I am your ally.
text:
Courtier • Calvary • Gaijin • Kshatriya • Tactician • Unique
After the first time each turn a Political action targets Kamalakar: Negate it's effects.
Battle: Kamalakar confounds the enemy. Move Kamalakar home or to a battlefield with enemy units.

name: The Ivory Coast
flavour: Most of the coast is in ruins. We will not disturb it, other than to harvest what resources remain within. The gods frown upon the wasteful. - Yoritomo Naizen
text:
Singular
Battle: Choose your performing Personality and bow this card: Move him home. Straighten his unit if he moved.

name: Master Scouts
flavour: I do not know them, but I know the look in their eyes. They will not betray us, my lord. We are all they have. - Yoritomo Singh
text:
Elite • Gaijin • Scout
After the resolution of a Recon action you took: Give this card +1F.

name: Coin Pouch
flavour: There are almost no problems that cannot be solved with sufficient funds. Unfortunately we no longer have sufficient funds. - Yoritomo Utemaro
text:
This card enters play bowed.
This Personality has +2 Gold Cost.
Reaction: When a Holding bows to produce Gold, bow this card: The Holding produces one additional Gold.

name: Colonist's Mark
flavour: All our people shall carry them, and they will be closely guarded. I will not suffer infiltration. - Moshi Kalani
text: Reaction: After an action targets this Personality, discard a card: Negate this Personality's movement from the action's effects.

name: All Within the World
flavour: Earth and sky, fire and water, Empire and the Kingdoms... all are the same if you but know how to look. - Isawa Kimi
text:
Unique
Battle/Open: If this Shugenja shares an element keyword with a Ring you control: Either straighten the Ring or this Shugenja.

name: Channeling the Fallen
flavour: The spirits in this land are strange indeed. They answer my prayers, but the sensation is completely different.
text:
Fire
This Shugenja has +5F.
Battle: Bow this card: Ranged 5 Attack, or Ranged 6 Attack if this Shugenja is Fire.

name: Economic Manipulation
flavour: A whisper in the competitor's ear and the objective is handled quite nicely. - Yasuki Jinn-Kuen
text:
Kolat
This card has -1 Gold Cost if you control a Merchant.
Limited: Target a Holding with a base Gold Cost of 4 or less controlled by a player who controls five or more Holdings: Destroy it.

name: A Brave New World
flavour: I will not lie to you, kinsman, Naizen said. "The journey will be unpleasant, and the work more difficult than you can imagine. The rewards, however, are without measure."
text: Battle: Choose your performing Personality and discard a card: Move your Personality to the current battlefield. Straighten his unit if he moved.

name: Quick Recovery
flavour: Steel yourselves, sisters! Yu-Pan shouted. "We have lost too many to allow minor setbacks to break us! Be unbending, and be victorious!"
text: Battle: Choose your performing Personality and target a bowed card in his unit (which may be him): Before this battle's resolution, straighten the targeted card.

name: Blessings of the Shi-Tien Yen-Wang
text:
Fortune • Unique
After your turn begins: You may choose your dead Personality and put him at the top of your deck.
Battle: Choose your performing opposed Personality and discard this card: The Lords of Death grant him strength. Give him +1F for each dead Personality in all players' discard piles. Negate the next card effect that bows, destroys, or moves him.

name: Jurojin's Blessing
flavour: The blessings of a long life can be considerable. Unfortunately, the burden that accompanies such a blessing is considerable as well. - Asako Moeru
text:
Fortune • Unique
Limited: Look at the top card of your Fate deck. You may discard it.
Open: Discard this card and target a non-Unique Strategy in your Fate discard pile: Put the Strategy into your hand.

name: Rebuilding Kyuden Hida
flavour: I cannot promise that it shall never fall again. But the Crab shall always be here to rebuild it. - Hida Kisada
text:
Unique
Until your second turn from now begins, the Attacker may not announce a Battle action before the Defender's first normal opportunity to act or pass in a battle.

name: Times of Strife
flavour: With the ranks of the Great Clans depleted, it was difficult to enforce the Empress' laws.
text:
Unique
Until your second turn from now begins, all provinces have a maximum strength equal to their base strength, and after each time another player who controls no units at the current battlefield announces a Battle action, he discards a card.

name: Harsh Choices
flavour: Take what we are owed. Leave the rest for the crows. - Kakita Idzuki
text:
Unique
You may destroy the province this Event was revealed in. If you did, draw 3 cards.

name: Formal Apology
flavour:
Five magistrates died! An entire district was burned to the ground!
"Yes, Shiba-san, and we shall address the consequences in time. Please, let us discuss how we might make amends..."
text:
Unique
After the next time this game your Honor is below its starting value, you have a tea ceremony; gain 5 Honor.

name: War Weariness
flavour: By the end of the Destroyer War, many had perished, much land went fallow, and even samurai learned the despair that comes with months of hunger.
text:
Unique
Until your second turn from now begins, after the resolution of the first action each phase that one or more Personalities performed, bow them.

name: Archery Range
flavour: Feel the arrow, children! Surrender to the flame, empty your soul, and strike with harmony.
text:
Dojo
Bow this card: Produce 2 Gold.
Reaction: After a Ranged Attack is targeted: Give it +1 strength.

name: Tranquil Garden
flavour: The years pass, but the search for enlightenment never changes.
text:
Temple
Bow this card: Produce 2 Gold.
Open: Bow this card, and target a Ring in play or in your discard pile: If the Ring is in play, straighten it. Otherwise, put it into your hand and destroy this card.

name: Red Crane Dojo
flavour: There are those who embrace unacceptable solutions...
text:
Ninja
Bow this card: Produce 3 Gold, or 4 Gold when paying for a Ninja card.
Reaction: Even if this card is bowed, after an action targets your Personality: Remove Ninja and Shadowlands from him until the action ends.

name: Temple of Hotei
flavour: It is simple to chase the thought of contentment. It is another to accept it entirely.
text:
Temple
Bow this card: Produce 2 Gold.
Limited: Bow your performing Shugenja: Gain 1 Honor.

name: Hida Mochitoko - exp
flavour: Faster, dogs! There are three more chests to carry and you fall behind schedule!
text:
Crab Clan • Jade • Samurai • Commander • Hero • Experienced • Unique • Advisor to the Ruby Champion
Reaction: Twice per turn, after an action targets your Follower at Mochitoko's location: Negate its bowing and destruction from that action's effects.

name: Hida Mimori
flavour: The Empire faced no wars as it recovered from the devastating push from Kali-Ma's forces. The Crab continued to train, fight, and wait.
text:
Crab Clan • Berserker
Battle: Target a bowed enemy card: Destroy it.

name: Hiruma Tensin
flavour: He loves paintings, laughter, and music. He has earned the respect and friendship of his superiors. He is no normal Hiruma, yet he is the perfect Crab.
text:
Crab Clan • Samurai • Scout
Battle: If you have Reconnaissance: Ranged 4 Attack.
Battle: Bow your performing Follower in Tensin's unit: Ranged 4 Attack.

name: Yasuki Tsujiken
flavour: What is this pittance? Come back when you are serious.
text:
Crab Clan • Courtier • Crime Boss • Merchant
Reaction: After Tsujiken enters play, target a Holding: Until Tsujiken leaves play, after each time its controller bows it, he loses 1 Honor.
Open: Bow Tsujiken and target a Holding: Straighten it. You may bow it if its base Gold Cost is 4 or lower.

name: Kaiu Watsuki
flavour: We sometimes play a game amongst each other. One Kaiu devises the strongest fortification possible, and the others must figure out its weaknesses. Me? I have never lost.
text: Crab Clan • Samurai • Siege • Tactician

name: Yasuki Jinn-Kuen - exp2
flavour: Rest, regroup, and restructure. We will never die.
text:
Crab Clan • Daimyo • Courtier • Kolat • Merchant • Experienced 2 • Loyal • Unique • Master Coin
Political Open: Target a Holding or Stronghold: Straighten it.
Political Reaction: After an action targets your Merchant, pay 2 Gold: Negate the action's effects.

name: Asahina Munefusa
flavour: My days are full of honorable duties, but when the wind blows I hear whispers of distant lands...
text:
Crane Clan • Air • Shugenja
Open: Target your Temple Holding: Straighten it.
Battle: Even if Munefusa is not at the current battlefield, target an attacking Personality: Move him home. If he moved, gain 1 Honor.

name: Doji Yoshitada
flavour: The Mantis need to be taught that their command of the sea ends at the dock. This port is my responsibility, and I will see that the laws of the Crane are upheld here.
text:
Crane Clan • Samurai • Duelist • Magistrate
Political Battle: Target an enemy Personality: Bow him. If he is dishonorable, choose a player who gains or loses 2 Honor.

name: Daidoji Yuki - exp
flavour: Of course, Ebizo-sama, I would be honored to help you capture him.
text:
Crane Clan • Samurai • Iron Crane • Scout • Experienced • Unique
Recon Reaction: After engaging at Yuki's battlefield, if all your Personalities there are Scouts: You have Reconnaissance there. You have the first opportunity in this battle to take a Battle action or pass.

name: Daidoji Ebizo
flavour: Finding men is an art all its own, and as a Crane it is my duty to excel in an art.
text:
Crane Clan • Samurai • Bounty Hunter • Iron Crane • Scout
After the resolution of your Recon action: Give Ebizo +1F.
Battle: Ranged Attack with strength equal to Ebizo's Force.

name: Kakita Maratai
flavour: Only through art do the deeds of heroes shine for a thousand years.
text:
Crane Clan • Artisan • Sculptor
Reaction: After a duel ends that your Personality won, bow Maratai: She sculpts a statue to honor the winner. Gain 2 Honor. Take the Imperial Favor.

name: Togashi Hizumi
flavour: There is truth in devastation.
text:
Dragon Clan • Earth • Monk • Empty Hand • Tattooed
Reaction: After the resolution of an action that bowed a Personality at Hizumi's battlefield, target the Personality: Negate his next straightening (this turn).
Battle: Give the current battlefield's province +4 or -4 strength.

name: Togashi Meiyu
flavour: The lord of this province has declared war on his neighbor? Why do you disturb us with such things? Resolve such minor squabbles yourselves.
text:
Dragon Clan • Fire • Monk • Tattooed
Reaction: After Meiyu enters play: Give her three +1F Fire tokens.

name: Mirumoto Ezuno
flavour: You will stand aside, or you will die. I will not tolerate inconvenience to myself or my charge.
text:
Dragon Clan • Samurai • Duelist • Yojimbo
Reaction: When another player's action would target one of your Shugenja at Ezuno's location: It targets Ezuno instead, if legal.

name: Kitsuki Horume
flavour: A worthy attempt! It has been an honor to face you. Surely, in your next life, you will prevail...
text:
Dragon Clan • Courtier • Duelist • Gamekeeper • Justicar • Magistrate
Reaction: After Horume enters play: Choose a player. He gains or loses 1 Honor.
Reaction: After a duel ends that Horume won: He boasts of his talents. Gain 1 Honor.

name: Mirumoto Yumaru
flavour: You are welcome to test your style against mine. To whom should I send your daisho?
text:
Dragon Clan • Samurai • Kensai
Battle: Target an enemy Personality: If Yumaru has a Weapon, you may move her home and you may move the Personality home. Otherwise, move both of them home.

name: Tamori Yayu
flavour: It is wonderful how the kami can be called upon to aid or to destroy, is it not?
text:
Dragon Clan • Earth • Shugenja • Alchemist • Mountaineer
Yayu has +2F and Cavalry while it is not your turn.
Battle: Bow or destroy one of Yayu's Spells: He lobs an alchemical potion at the enemy. Ranged 5 Attack.

name: Tamori Ruya
flavour: Redemption. That is what we seek. Our family was founded by a traitor, and his successor also came from our ranks. We may never be able to cleanse the stain of that shame, but our duty demands that we try.
text:
Dragon Clan • Earth • Shugenja • Alchemist • Unique
Reaction: After the resolution of your action that bowed a Personality, target a Personality at the same location: Bow him.

name: Kitsu Fukui
flavour: There is nothing more important than protecting our past for the sake of the future.
text:
Lion Clan • Water • Shugenja • Head Librarian
Battle: Bow or destroy your performing Ancestor Personality, and target an enemy card: Bow it. Gain 1 Honor.

name: Kitsu Akai
flavour: With your help I shall avenge your death, brother.
text:
Lion Clan • Water • Shugenja
Limited: Create a 2F/2C/3PH Lion Clan • Samurai • Ancestor • Spirit Personality.
Battle: Bow your performing Ancestor Personality and target an enemy card without attachments: Destroy it. Gain 1 Honor.

name: Ikoma Sugo

flavour: Every man dreams of exceeding his father's deeds. For me that is likely impossible.
text:
Crab Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Veteran • Unique • Wyrm Rider • Soul of Hida Tobashi
While Watari has exactly one Follower, that Follower has Cavalry.
Fear Battle: Target an enemy unit: Bow all Followers with 3 or lower Force in it.

name: Kaiu Kawachi
flavour: Other families wage war, but the Kaiu literally make war. Our every endeavor furthers the cause of the Crab military. We are the architects of destruction, the artisans of death.
text: Crab Clan • Samurai • Siege • Tactician

name: Kaiu Esumi
flavour: Some men are great leaders because of their innate billiance. Others, because of a terrible cruelty. - Kaiu Kawachi
text:
Crab Clan • Samurai • Siege • Tactician
Battle: Ranged 4 Attack. If this targeted a card, give the current battlefield's province +2 or -2 strength.

name: Toritaka Shishido
flavour: The other families protect the Empire from the Shadowlands, but we Toritaka protect it from the Spirit Realms. It is a different task, but the similarities and dangers are many.
text:
Crab Clan • Samurai • Scout • Soul of Toritaka Okabe
Ranged Attacks from actions performed by cards in Shishido's army have +1 strength.

name: Yasuki Tanimura
flavour: The finest knives in Rokugan!
text:
Crab Clan • Courtier • Merchant
Reaction: When paying for an action: Produce 3 Gold.
Political Reaction: After another player's Battle action targets Tanimura: The player may pay 4 Gold. If he did not pay the Gold, he loses 3 Honor.

name: Asahina Michiru
flavour: I will cause no harm to our enemies, but I will not allow harm to come to you either.
text:
Crane Clan • Air • Shugenja
Open: Target your Personality: Michiru creates a barrier of air. Before the next time (this turn) another player's action destroys the Personality, negate that destruction and move him home.

name: Asahina Yasutora
flavour:
What do you see, when you look out over the land? Makoto asked.
"My Champion, I am listening to the kami. The wind is full of their voices."
"It would be very useful to be able to track your enemies armies in such a fashion."
"It is more than that; it is a reminder that enemies themselves can change into friends with a shift of the wind."
text: Crane Clan • Air • Shugenja

name: Doji Tatsuki
flavour: The students of Doji Ayano fill the courts like pests. Elegant, brilliant pests. I would damn her for it, but truthfully I find intelligent opponents far less tedious than stupid ones. - Bayushi Nitoshi
text: Crane Clan • Samurai • Courtier • Soul of Doji Ayano

name: Doji Shunya
flavour: Our champion is brilliant and charming. How fortunate I know how to make use of these advantages.
text:
Crane Clan • Courtier • Soul of Doji Yoshiaga
Political Limited: Discard the Imperial Favor: Gain 2 Honor.

name: Doji Makoto
flavour: I am the lord of the Crane. I will allow no one to harm my clan.
text:
Crane Clan • Clan Champion • Courtier • Samurai • Duelist • Loyal • Unique
Political Open: Makoto uses his mastery of politics. Take the Imperial Favor.
Iaijutsu Battle: Target an enemy Personality: Makoto duels him. Destroy the duel's loser.

name: Doji Atsumichi
flavour: The Empire is full of samurai who have been trained for a war that may never come in their lifetime. It is fortunate we have the Colonies to draw their attention and give them the challenge they crave.
text:
Crane Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Soul of Doji Tadenori
Battle: Target a Personality with lower Personal Honor: Bow or straighten him.

name: Kakita Genshi
flavour: No, I do not think so.
text:
Crane Clan • Samurai • Artisan • Duelist • Master of Ceremonies • Soul of Kakita Yosuga
Iaijutsu Limited: Target another player's Personality. His controller may dishonor him. If he did not choose to dishonor him, gain 1 Honor and choose one of the Personality's abilities; it may not be used until your next turn begins.

name: Kakita Tadanobu
flavour: In the moment of the duel, you think of the duel, and only the duel. After you win, you can think about how much your lord will benefit from your victory.
text:
Crane Clan • Samurai • Duelist • Unique • Soul of Kakita Soichi
Political Reaction: After the resolution of an action that created a duel that Tadanobu won, discard the Imperial Favor: Draw 2 cards.

name: Kakita Kazan
flavour: You are a shame on your lord and your family. These are my words, and I will prove them with my sword if necessary.
text:
Crane Clan • Samurai • Commander • Duelist • Magistrate • Soul of Kakita Idzuki
Battle: Target an enemy dishonorable Personality: Bow him. His controller loses 2 Honor. Gain 2 Honor.

name: Mirumoto Katagi
flavour: These blades are my burden. No other is fit to bear them.
text:
Dragon Clan • Samurai • Kensai • Unique
Weapons attached to Katagi will not be transferred.
Non-Unique Weapons attaching to Katagi from your hand enter play paying 4 less Gold.

name: Kitsuki Kinaro
flavour: Most courtiers see the Kitsuki Method as an insult to tradition, a defiance of the idea that once a samurai has spoken, nothing else matters. The Kitsuki, for their part, do not care how others feel about their techniques.
text: Dragon Clan • Courtier • Duelist • Magistrate • Soul of Kitsuki Nakai

name: Kitsuki Yataku
flavour: The protocol is obvious, as are the obligations of the challenged in this instance.
text:
Dragon Clan • Samurai • Justicar • Soul of Kitsuki Yasu
Political Reaction: After an action targets a target Samurai, bow Yataku: The Samurai's controller may not choose to refuse any challenge created by the action.

name: Mirumoto Reiyu
flavour: Like her mentor, Reiyu expresses herself with her blades when her words are no longer up to the task.
text:
Dragon Clan • Samurai • Kensai • Poet • Soul of Mirumoto Tsubasa
Battle: Target an enemy Personality or Follower: Give it a Force penalty equal to Reiyu's Force.

name: Mirumoto Shikei
flavour: My bloodline? I am Dragon. I will not be defined by you.
text:
Dragon Clan • Clan Champion • Naga • Monk • Samurai • Duelist • Kensai • Tattooed • Loyal • Unique
Limited: Shikei meditates. Draw a card.
Iaijutsu Battle: Target an enemy Personality: Shikei duels him. Destroy the duel's loser.

name: Tamori Muzu
flavour: Two bottles will be sufficient. You do want some to survive, after all.
text:
Dragon Clan • Earth • Shugenja • Alchemist
Your other Earth Personalities have +1F while defending.
Battle: Target an enemy card: Bow it if it is attacking or has no attachments. Gain 1 Honor.

name: Togashi Torazu
flavour: My enlightenment shall be found in battle, on the bodies of my victims.
text:
Dragon Clan • Fire • Monk • Tattooed • Soul of Togashi Shintaro

Battle: Destroy a Fire token on Torazu: Ranged 3 Attack.

name: Akodo Dairuko
flavour: A Lion's duty is always foremost, but duty changes over time.
text:
Lion Clan • Clan Champion • Samurai • Paragon • Tactician • Loyal • Unique

Battle: Melee 8 Attack.

name: Matsu Hachiro
flavour: Completely devoid of ambition, his only desire was to wreak havoc in the name of the Lion. His only fear was lasting peace.
text:
Lion Clan • Samurai • Soul of Matsu Gohei
Hachiro has +2F while attacking.

name: Akodo Makotai
flavour: It is the destiny of the Lion to lead. This is not hubris, but simple truth. All could benefit from our leadership.
text:
Lion Clan • Samurai • Commander • Tactician • Soul of Akodo Mirotai
Tactical Limited: Create a 2F Follower and attach it to Makotai.

name: Matsu Arata
flavour: Greatness should be the goal of every samurai. This is not for their gratification, but to honor those who came before them.
text:
Lion Clan • Samurai • Justicar • Paragon • Soul of Matsu Nishijo
Arata has +2F while attacking.
Battle: Target an enemy Personality or Follower: Give it a Force penalty equal to Arata's Personal Honor. Gain 1 Honor.

name: Kitsu Sorano
flavour: Many samurai speak of their ancestors. We speak to them. They are more than our history. They are our land, our bodies, our soul. With them, we are everything. Without them, we are nothing.
text: Lion Clan • Water • Shugenja

name: Matsu Yuuto
flavour: He took a name that means 'gentle' when he became an adult. I assume it was an attempt at irony. - Kitsu Tamasine
text:
Lion Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Soul of Matsu Agetoki
Ranged Attacks may not target cards in this unit.

name: Matsu Hana
flavour: Strength of mind, body and spirit. If you are missing even one, you will not stand.
text:
Lion Clan • Samurai • Paragon • Unique • Soul of Matsu Fumiyo Experienced
Fear Battle: Target an enemy unit: Bow each card in it with equal or lower Force than Hana. Gain 1 Honor for each card this bowed.

name: Ikoma Shinju
flavour: When possible, choose the terrain on which to fight. When not possible, destroy the terrain your opponent has chosen.
text:
Lion Clan • Samurai • Scout
Battle: Target a Terrain and an enemy card without attachments: Destroy both targets.

name: Tsuruchi Isas
flavour: My arrow and its perfect flight is the only thing that never strays. I will never love or trust again. I serve my clan, and that is the only thing that defines me.
text:
Mantis Clan • Naval • Skirmisher • Soul of Mukami
Battle: Bow Isas: Ranged 3 Attack. Move Isas home.

name: Yoritomo Nakoshi
flavour: The other clans dwell in cages made of trees, of mountains, of grasses. They have no idea what it means to be free.
text: Mantis Clan • Samurai • Naval • Scout • Soul of Yoritomo Saburo

name: Tsuruchi Tomaru
flavour: I never dreamed to find myself in a land such as this, with wonders such as these. If this is my duty, then truly I have been blessed.
text:
Mantis Clan • Samurai • Scout
Battle: Twice per turn: Ranged 3 Attack.

name: Tsuruchi Samuru
flavour: He is the greatest hunter in the realm. He tracked a traitor across the Colonies and mainland Rokugan for seven months. He returned with his head. - Yoritomo Hiromi
text:
Mantis Clan • Samurai • Magistrate • Yojimbo • Unique • Soul of Tsuruchi Mochisa Experienced
Battle: Ranged 6 Attack that you compare against Gold Cost.

name: Tsuruchi Kosoko
flavour: Brilliant, beautiful, and virtuous. She is all that is right and true within our clan. We can become greater if we but become more like her. - Yoritomo Hiromi
text:
Mantis Clan • Samurai • Soul of Tsuruchi Saya
Battle: Ranged 5 Attack.

name: Moshi Madoka
flavour: The Dragon of Thunder blessed us years ago. Our clan maintains our devotion to the dragon still. We will not relinquish our commitment, no matter what dissension may strike it.
text: Mantis Clan • Thunder • Shugenja • Scout

name: Yoritomo Hiromi
flavour: His brooding rage has given him the name Growing Storm.
text:
Mantis Clan • Clan Champion • Thunder • Samurai • Naval • Loyal • Unique
Bowing, destruction, and movement from Battle actions Hiromi performs will not be negated or delayed.

name: Yoritomo Hama
flavour: Only the citizens of our Great Clan matter. I will lie to and cheat other samurai as I need to bring wealth to the Mantis.
text:
Mantis Clan • Samurai • Extortionist • Magistrate • Naval • Soul of Yoritomo Manzo
Battle: Target a card with lower Gold Cost in a unit: Bow or straighten the target.

name: Yoritomo Naoto
flavour: I ply the seas in the name of my lord. I serve him faithfully in all things. This does not require me to find delight in his every action.
text:
Mantis Clan • Samurai • Naval • Soul of Yoritomo Isoshi
Battle: Target an enemy unit: Until this battle ends, abilities on cards now in that unit may not be used.

name: Kitsune Gina
flavour: Tell me, brother... Where have the smugglers hidden the cache?
text:
Mantis Clan • Earth • Shugenja

name: Agasha Ryo
flavour: The harmony and prosperity the Empire has enjoyed has simply proven than we were correct in our love of peace. Abundance and wisdom flower when weapons are put aside.

Phoenix Clan • Void • Shugenja • Acolyte • Soul of Agasha Seruma

Battle: Target an enemy Personality: Bow him. If he is Kolat, Ninja, or Shadowlands, choose a player, who gains or loses 2 Honor.

flavour: I fear that the matters in the Second City will create trouble here in the Empire, Tsukimi said. Niou laughed. "We create our own troubles, Tsukimi-sama, and then make up stories about how they came to be. But you of all people should know how easy it is to see the truth of the world."
text: Phoenix Clan • Void • Monk • Henshin

name: Asako Yorisada
flavour: You cannot stand if you are out of harmony with your earth. Here, I will show you.
text:
Phoenix Clan • Earth • Monk • Henshin
Battle: Target a Personality whose Force is different from his base Force: Bow or straighten him.

name: Isawa Tomohiro
flavour: I do not understand my cousin. What could be so interesting about a city made up of the same five elements to be found here at home? What could be more fascinating than the dance of the elements, and how they are all like and unlike the void?
text: Phoenix Clan • Air • Void • Shugenja • Alchemist • Ishiken • Soul of Isawa Kumai

name: Isawa Shunsuko
flavour: The sea, the sea! Someday I will travel to the new Colonies, and see the marvelous city I hear tales of. Until then I will listen to the ocean's whispers of it.
text: Phoenix Clan • Water • Shugenja • Cavalry • Soul of Isawa Yutako

flavour: I abide.
text:

flavour: The Shiba stand ready to die in the defense of the clan. That has been our glory since the days of our first ancestors.
text:
Phoenix Clan • Samurai • Yojimbo • Soul of Shiba Danjuro

flavour: The Scorpion always stand ready to avenge their fallen.

Scorpion Clan • Courtier • Soul of Shosuro Takuro

flavour: Soon, old crimes shall be avenged.
text:
Scorpion Clan • Clan Champion • Courtier • Ninja • Samurai • Sociopath • Loyal • Unique • Shoju's Soul

name: Bayushi Waru
flavour: No! I will not hear more of your lies! You insulted my master, and for that you will suffer unspeakably!
text:
Scorpion Clan • Samurai • Paragon • Yojimbo • Loyal

name: Soshi Yorimi
flavour: Do you see any reason to doubt that I have lived in harmony with the elements?
text:
Scorpion Clan • Air • Courtier • Shugenja • Unique • Soul of Shosuro Dazai Experienced

name: Bayushi Hurunayi
flavour: Ninja? Do not be foolish. I have found no evidence that they exist, let alone were involved in this theft. - Kitsuki Kinaro
text:
Scorpion Clan • Courtier • Ninja • Soul of Bayushi Muraisan
Open: Remove Ninja from Harunayi.

name: Bayushi Kahoku
flavour: The secret of the Final Lesson is passed down from one generation to the next, with one man carrying it each time.
text:
Scorpion Clan • Samurai • Final Student • Magistrate
Kahoku has +2F while another player controls a dishonorable Personality.
Battle: Ranged 3 Attack, with +2 strength if the target is dishonorable.

name: Bayushi Mitsuo
flavour: What became of my uncle Muhito, Crane? I know you know something, and I will find out what it is, no matter the cost.
text:
Scorpion Clan • Ninja • Samurai • Soul of Bayushi Muhito
Reaction: After the resolution of a Battle action that moved Mitsuo: Take an additional Battle action.

name: Daigotsu Misaki
flavour: Cultists, creatures, and demons! All fall before me like wheat before the scythe!
text:
Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Samurai • Commander • Conqueror
Followers attaching to Misaki enter play paying 2 less Gold.
Battle: Bow Misaki's performing Follower: Melee Attack with strength equal to the Follower's Force.

name: Daigotsu Negishi
flavour: These jungles hold horrors such as make the Shadowlands sound like a paradise.
text:
Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Samurai • Soul of Daigotsu Arima
After Negishi enters play: Lose 1 Honor.
Battle/Open: Target your Personality: Straighten him.

name: Daigotsu Gyoken
flavour: I was born corrupted, but among the Spider there is no limit to how high I can rise. Ultimately we are answerable to the Empress, but in the short term it is only power that matters.
text:
Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Samurai
After Gyoken enters play: Lose 1 Honor.

name: Daigotsu Ishibashi
flavour: They think us without discipline? Who among them could carve a world from this primal wasteland as we have?
text:
Spider Clan • Samurai • Gunso • Paragon • Dark Resolve • Soul of Daigotsu Shiraki
Fear Battle: Show a Dark Virtue card in your hand: Ranged Attack with strength equal to the card's Focus Value plus one.

name: Daigotsu Kanpeki - exp
flavour: Bow before me, or fall before me.
text:
Spider Clan • Clan Champion • Monk • Samurai • Kensai • Paragon • Experienced • Loyal • Unique
Reaction: After the resolution of a Battle action from a Strategy, if Kanpeki performed it: Take an additional Battle action.
Battle: Target an enemy Personality with lower Force: Kanpeki snaps him like a twig: Destroy him.

name: Daigotsu Aya
flavour: My father was an Imperial Guard. One day I shall stand within the Imperial Palace as he did.
text:
Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Samurai • Paragon • Unique • Dark Perfection • Soul of Daigotsu Setsuko Experienced
After Aya enters play: Lose 2 Honor and you may put a Dark Virtue from your discard pile into your hand.
Open: Give Aya Cavalry, Duelist, or Tactician.

name: Ohaba
flavour: They willingly revere the Fallen Kami without accepting his blessings. They claim membership in the Spider Clan but remain within the Empire. These monks are a living contradiction. Perhaps in that they find wisdom. - Mirumoto Shikei
text: Spider Clan • Monk • Kensai • Order of the Spider • Soul of Momiji

name: Moto Rani
flavour: Rani was a beautiful, bubbly child before she learned of her talents. Now? Frankly, she scares me. - Moto Taha
text: Unicorn Clan • Water • Shugenja • Cavalry • Death Priest

name: Moto Tetsuo
flavour: The notion that the Lady Shinjo reborn should become a Mirumoto is a blasphemy. The Dragon should suffer for their audacity in even suggesting such a thing!
text:
Unicorn Clan • Samurai • White Guard • Soul of Moto Shanyu
Battle: If you control any Cavalry units at the current battlefield: Move Tetsuo there. If he moved, Ranged 4 Attack.

name: Moto Naleesh
flavour: The Living Goddess leads her Clan with grace and cunning.
text:
Unicorn Clan • Clan Champion • Naga • Samurai • Cavalry • Commander • Kami • Paragon • Tactician • Loyal • Unique
Naleesh's unit straightens during each player's Straighten Phase.
Battle: Target an enemy unit: Naleesh overruns it. Bow it. Destroy all cards in it without attachments and without Cavalry.

name: Shinjo Taeken
flavour: My father stood proud before the Empire and claimed the mantle of the Topaz Champion in Tsuma. I can do no less for my clan!
text: Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Commander • Soul of Shinjo Tae-hyun

name: Moto Shigeru
text:
Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Soul of Moto Gurban
Shigeru has +1F while she has an Item.

name: Shinjo Itao
flavour: Life on the sea, freedom? The idea is laughable. Freedom is the wind and the plains, feeling the ground race beneath your steed's hooves. The sea is nothing but churning and sickness.
text:
Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Soul of Shinjo Goshi
Reaction: After Itao enters play, target a Follower in your hand: Attach it to Itao, paying all costs.

name: Shinjo Horibe
flavour: Our duty is to secure the land route to the Colonies, and we will not falter. Be proud, brothers! We are the guardians of the Empire!
text:
Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Commander • Soul of Shinjo Hwarang
Battle: If Horibe is opposed, target a Personality: Bow or straighten him.

name: Shinjo Ki-Chang - exp
flavour: He is old, but he will not leave my side. His wisdom had proven invaluable countless times. - Moto Naleesh
text:
Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Commander • Tactician • Experienced • Unique
Reaction: After your target Personality enters play: Create a 1F Cavalry Follower and attach it to him.

name: Moto Taha
flavour: The Unicorn will be the Right Hand of the Iweko dynasty. We must fightr and prove our worth to the Imperial Dynasty.
text: Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Tactician • Soul of Moto Munoru

name: Utaku Ryoko
flavour: The Utaku Battle Maidens form the greatest heavy cavalry unit in the world. Their strength is unrivaled.
text:
Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Battle Maiden • Cavalry • Paragon • Soul of Utaku Liu-Xeung
Reaction: After engaging at Ryoko's battlefield, target a Personality or Follower opposing her: Give it a Force penalty equal to Ryoko's Personal Honor.

name: Daigotsu Matsuda
flavour: Do not all samurai inherit their father's weapon? Most receive a blade, but I consider this no different.
text:
Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Samurai • Paragon • Obsidian Claw • Soul of Daigotsu Kurai
After Matsuda enters play: Lose 1 Honor.

name: Ten Thousand Temples
flavour: Some called it the Temple of the Builders, as there was always a shrine under construction.
text:
Temple • Singular

Limited: If your Family Honor is 9 or lower, bow this card: Gain 1 Honor.

name: Kaiu Village

Unique

Reaction: After your performing Personality enters play from a province, pay 2 Gold: Create a +1F Armor Item and attach it to him.

flavour: The sisters abide there still. Are they the original sisters, or newcomers? Does it matter? - Togashi Osawa
text:
Singular

name: Apprentice Shinobi
flavour: Do nothing but observe, and survive to report. Your skills are insufficient for anything more, and your death serves no purpose. - Shosuro Aroru
text:
Ninja
After the resolution of a Ninja action: Give this card +1F.

name: Hiruma Sniper
flavour: Take the shot if you have it, gunso. If you can do it with one arrow, please do. I despise inefficiency. - Hida Kisada
text:
Scout

name: Legion of Pain
flavour: We serve the Empress as our lord commands, but our appetites remain unsatisfied.
text:
Shadowlands • Lost

name: Khol Regulars

text:
Cavalry
Battle: Ranged 4 Attack.

name: Shinjo's Children

text: Cavalry

name: Village Guardian
flavour: Calm yourself, man! Get the others and form a bucket line. The fire must be put out quickly, and have the women check the adjacent buildings for any sign of embers. We dare not risk the harvest this close to tax season. Now move!
text: Reaction: After this card enters play from your hand: Draw one card for each player who has had a province destroyed this game.

name: Outriders
flavour: The Colonies can only be reached by land under the protection of the Unicorn, or by sea on the ships of the Mantis. Both paths are treacherous, Empress, but both can be relied upon. - The Imperial Herald
text: Cavalry

name: Stalking Tiger
flavour: The Ivory Kingdoms have been witness to countless tragedies, but the predators have never left.
text:
Nonhuman • Cat
Battle: Melee 6 Attack.

name: Armor of the Heavens
flavour: Some suits of armor are associated with prestigious positions, and long legacies of honorable duty. Serious consequences result from striking at their wearers.
text:
Armor • Imperial
Political Reaction: After another player targets this Personality with an action: Choose a player, who gains or loses 2 Honor.

name: Maga-yari
flavour: It is a weapon most popular among certain sects of Lion bushi, but it has gained some popularity among other clans as well. - Kaiu Onizuka
text:
Weapon
This card will not be transferred.
Attaches to a Paragon or Kensai paying 3 less Gold.

name: Chrysanthemum Blossom
flavour: The blossoms are signs of favor from the throne and the courts. Those bearing these treasures find that the Empire is eager to laud their accomplishments on the battlefield.
text:
Imperial
Reaction: After this Personality is assigned: Give him a +1F token. Gain 1 Honor.

name: Modifications
flavour:
That... is a very strange weapon.
"I have faced very strange opponents."

Weapon

flavour:
I can hit the bird from one hundred paces!
"Only one hundred?"
text:
Weapon
Battle: Bow this card: Ranged 5 Attack.

name: Hanabi
flavour: Above all else, shugenja are priests, holy men and women entrusted with sacred duties. The Empire turns to them for wisdom and guidance. Their presence is welcomed with open arms during weddings, festivals, and other events of importance, and their approval brings great honor upon their hosts.
text:
Unique
Political Limited: Bow this Shugenja and destroy this card: Gain 4 Honor.

name: Unnatural Flood
flavour: When the enemy cannot be broken, find a way to prevent him from arriving at the conflict. - Tangen's Lies
text:
Water • Unique
Battle: Bow this Shugenja and target an enemy Personality: Move him home; if this Shugenja is Water, this movement will not be negated. If the target moved, bow him and negate his (future) movement.

name: Thunder's Favor
flavour: The magic of the elements can do many things: it can heal, it can teach, it can carry people and ideas over great distances. However, the magic of Thunder can do something I consider far more noteworthy: it can destroy. - Moshi Madoka
text:
Thunder
Battle: Bow this card: Ranged 4 Attack, or Ranged 6 Attack if this Shugenja is Thunder.

name: Warded Paths
flavour: The Tamori have learned many secrets from the mountains. One that they use particularly often is how to deny their foes access to key areas.
text:
Earth
While this Shugenja is defending, he has +3F.
While this Shugenja is Earth and you are the Defender, you decide the order in which battles resolve.

name: Ancestral Protection
flavour: Grandfather! Thank you for answering my prayers. I am glad I have the strength of Akodo Jin by my side.
text: Reaction: After an action targets your Personality, destroy your performing Ancestor: Negate the action's effects.

name: A Stain Cleansed
flavour: Asahina Keitaro's disgrace is rarely discussed. A hidden alliance of Dragon and Crane samurai scour the land to destroy all of the fallen daimyo's Tainted creations.
text: Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Magistrate, target an enemy card without attachments or an enemy unit, and pay Gold equal to the card or unit's total Gold Cost minus 2: Destroy it.

name: A Forefather's Vengeance
flavour: Tengoku may have receded, but Yomi will never abandon its descendants.
text:
Limited: Gain 3 Honor, or 1 Honor for each Ancestor you have in play, whichever is lower.
Battle: Destroy your performing unbowed Ancestor and target an enemy card without attachments: Destroy it.

name: Bad Kharma
flavour: Do not lose hope, brother. Our folly will never be uncovered.
text: Reaction: After another player with Family Honor of -1 or lower announces an action on a Strategy: He ignores the action's costs. Negate its effects.

name: Besieged
flavour: The Crab Clan's work is never done.
text:
Siege • Unique
Open: Destroy a performing Personality you own and control: Increase or decrease the strength of all players' provinces by an amount equal to the Personality's base Chi.

name: Blind Rage
flavour: What do you say now? Does the workmanship still look shoddy?
text: Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Berserker: Give him +5F. Lose 2 Honor.

name: Goju Kobashi
flavour: Such a place, so teeming with life. My hunger shall never go unfulfilled!
text:
Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Ninja • Consumer
After Kobashi enters play: Lose 1 Honor.
Battle: Target an enemy attachment: Kobashi consumes it. Destroy it. You may target one of your Ninja, create a 1F Shadowlands • Ninja Follower, and attach it to him.

name: Burn the Towers
flavour: The beauty of the plains is without equal, but the risk of fire during the summer months is one that can never be ignored.
text:
Recon
Reaction: After engaging, choose your performing unbowed Scout Personality at the current battlefield: You have Reconnaissance there. Give its province -3 strength.

name: Obscured Pathways
flavour: The Kitsune smiled. "All forests are one."

Earth • Forest
While this Shugenja is Earth, this card's Battle ability may be used even if this unit is not at the current battlefield.
Battle: Bow this Shugenja if he is home, bow this card and target an attacking Personality: Move him home.

name: Falling Leaf Strike
flavour: Impossible? Only because you believe it to be so!
text:
Kiho
Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Monk and target an enemy Personality or Follower: Move your Monk to the current battlefield. Give the target -3F. Bow it if its Force is now 0.

name: Bend like a Reed
flavour: Unconventional tactics can be frowned upon in a formal duel, but a desperate man will do whatever he must to survive.
text:
You may only play one copy of Bend like a Reed per duel.
Reaction: Before Focus Effects resolve, if your performing Personality in the duel did not strike: Give him +2 to his duel stat until the duel ends.

name: Flooded Pass
flavour: Who knew inconvenience could be so beautiful? - Shinjo Itao
text:
Terrain
This province has +2 strength for each unit in the attacking army.
Battle: Even if you control no units at the current battlefield, if there are no Terrains there: Put this card into play there.

name: Footsteps of Madness
flavour: Unlike some other clans, we keep a close watch on our holdings in the new lands, to prevent embarassing incidents from occuring. - Yasuki Jinn-Kuen
text: Reaction: Before the resolution of an action from a Stronghold, pay Gold equal to the Stronghold's base Gold Production: Negate the action's effects.

name: Fortitude
flavour: Come at me again, demon! Come at me a hundred times and be turned away one hundred and one!
text: Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Berserker and target an enemy unit with lower total Force than your Berserker's base Force: Bow the target. Negate all current and new Force penalties on your Berserker from actions.

name: Hard Pressed
flavour: A true vassal of the Scorpion must be prepared to face any foe at any time. Only through victory can your loyalty be assured. - Shosuro Aroru
text:
Terrain
Before this battle's resolution: Move a unit home from the current battlefield. You may bow it.
Battle: If there are no Terrains in play at the current battlefield: Put this card into play there.

name: He's Mine!
flavour: Duels in Rokugan are ritualized. The challenge, the terms, and the ceremony are all subject to centuries of tradition. One tradition is the privilege of having another to stand in the place of the challenged, when circumstances are right.
text: Reaction: Before your target Personality enters a duel, bow him and choose your performing unbowed Samurai at the same location: Your Samurai enters the duel instead. Bow him after the duel ends.

name: Heart of Rokugan
flavour: Not today, demon! Not today or any other day!
text:
Terrain
Before this battle resolves: Give each of your Human Personalities and Followers at the current battlefield +1F, and give each Nonhuman Personality and Follower there -1F.
Battle: If there are no Terrains at the current battlefield: Put this card into play there.

name: Breath of the Heavens
flavour: Do I like my sake chilled? Do not be ridiculous!
text:
Fire • Tattoo
Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Fire or Tattooed Personality: Ranged 3 Attack with +1 strength for each Fire token on your Personality. Give your Personality a +1F Fire token.

name: No Hiding Place
legal: open gold diamond lotus samurai emperor
flavour: Of course I told him to take his offer and begone. I have no patience for such an affront, and I am perfectly safe in this house.
text: Reaction: After you announce an action with a Ranged Attack: Give one Ranged Attack from the action -1 strength. That Ranged Attack may target a card in the Defender's home (if otherwise legal).

name: Selfless Defense
flavour: Duty is never sacrifice.
text:
Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Yojimbo Personality and target an enemy Personality: Move him home. Bow him if you control a Courtier or Shugenja.
Battle: Destroy your performing Yojimbo and target one or more of your Courtier or Shugenja Personalities: Move them home.

name: Introspection
flavour: The notion of enlightenment is ephemeral, but the Empire seeks it anyway. Countless individuals search, and each comes away with a different lesson.
text: Reaction: After one of your Rings enters play: Search your Fate deck for a card. Put it in your hand.

name: Hundred-Fold Cut
flavour: Arrows. Swords. Men. Nothing stops a kensai whose blades are ready.
text:
Reaction: After another player's action targets your performing Kensai, bow or destroy one of his Weapons: Negate his destruction from the action's effects.
Battle: Bow your performing Kensai or one of his Weapons: Draw two cards.

name: Guided by Honor
flavour: My cause is just, and my mien, righteous. You will not impede my path.
text: Battle: If any enemy units are at the current battlefield, choose your performing unbowed Paragon: Move him to the current battlefield. If he moved, you may target and bow an enemy Personality with equal or lower Personal Honor.

name: Torch's Flame Flickers
flavour: Do not underestimate the Hiruma. Other Crab may be brutes, but the Hiruma are exceedingly dangerous. - Shosuro Aroru
text:
Recon
Reaction: After engaging, choose your performing Scout at the current battlefield: You have Reconnaissance there. Negate the next card effect that bows one or more of your Personalities who is there (at the time).

name: Murderous Intent
flavour: We are certain this ronin is the culprit, the magistrate said. "Execute him at once," Bayushi Nitoshi said. "The murderer of Otomo Teruken should not be allowed even a minute more of life than necessary."
text: Battle/Open: Choose your performing Paragon: Give him +1F for each of his keywords except "Soul of" keywords. Lose 4 Honor.

name: One Koku
flavour:
This card is worth one koku.
"The Yasuki Daimyo is as slippery as a live fish and metaphorically as smelly as an old one. He has a mind only for money and the power it brings. A dangerous opponent, and one I plan to keep an eye on." - Doji Dainagon
text: Reaction: When paying a Gold Cost: Produce one Gold.

name: Summoned to Justice
flavour: Even when armies stand idle, the cause of justice is never still.
text:
Political
Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Courtier at any location and target an attacking Personality: Move him home. If he moved, bow him. If he is dishonorable, his controller loses Honor equal to his base Personal Honor.

name: Prosperous Village
flavour: Prosperity brings men and women of destiny, which in turn only enhances a village's prosperous nature. - Yung
text:
Enters play paying 1 less Gold for each Personality you control.
Bow this card: Produce 5 Gold.

name: Rhetoric
flavour: I have heard the tale differently.
text:
Political
Reaction: Before a player gains or loses Honor from an action's effects, bow your performing Courtier: Choose another player. If the Courtier's Chi is higher than or equal to the Honor gain or loss, the chosen player instead of the original player takes the gain or loss.

name: The Fires of War
flavour: In the long years since the Destroyer War, only one war between the clans marred the Empire: that of the Phoenix and Scorpion. The War of the Twins was unfortunate, and cost many lives. May we never see its like again. - The Miya Histories
text:
Unique
Battle/Open: You may use each ability on your Stronghold a second time this turn.

name: Immovable Object
flavour: Wounds that would incapacitate or even cripple lesser warriors merely serve to anger berserkers.
text:
Battle/Open: Choose your performing Berserker: Straighten him.
Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Berserker and target an enemy Personality or Follower with lower Force: Bow it.

name: Snake Tattoo
flavour: The rivalry among the monks of the Dragon and Spider never fully resolved, but bloodshed was rare.
text:
Tattoo
Reaction: After another player's Battle action targets your Tattooed Personality: Move him to an adjacent battlefield. If he is no longer a legal target for that action, negate its effects.

name: Sniping
flavour: Protecting the forests did not always mean protecting them from external threats. Not all their denizens were benign. Not all spirits were pure.
text: Reaction: After a Ranged Attack is targeted: Give it a strength bonus equal to its current strength.

name: Spinning Heel Kick
flavour: With the monks, it is difficult to tell where mastery of the body ends and mastery of the spirit begins.
text:
Air • Kiho
Battle: Choose your performing Monk: Straighten him. You may take an additional Battle action, which he must perform.

name: Well Prepared
legal: open gold diamond lotus samurai emperor
flavour: Two and a half decades of peace can make a man weak and complacent. I will not have such things. We will have active drills twice per week. There will be no further breaches of the Second City. - Akodo Tsudoken
text: Battle: If you control a Terrain, target a card in a unit: Bow or straighten it.

name: Strength in Terror
flavour: It is a strategy not lost upon the samurai of Rokugan. Look at their mempo. Some among us do not require such adornments, however. - Daigotsu Kanpeki
text:
Fear
Battle: Choose your performing Paragon and target an enemy Personality: Reduce his Force by an amount equal to your Paragon's Force. You may target and destroy one of the Personality's attachments. Lose 3 Honor.

name: Strength of Purity
flavour: Honor is a well from which a samurai can draw great strength. When you have your honor you never fight alone. - The Journals of Utagawa
text: Battle: Choose your performing Personality with 3 or higher Personal Honor: Give him +3F.

name: Veteran Advisor
flavour: We are only ronin warriors and they do not trust us. I've stolen the tactics used in every battle the Lion Clan has fought for the last twenty years. These should prove useful if we ever need new employment, brother.
text: Battle: Draw a card.

name: Tell the Tale
flavour: Twenty five years ago today, the age that the Ikoma and Miya historians have chosen to call the Age of Conquest began. - Matsu Kasei
text: Limited: Gain 1 Honor.

name: The Compassion of the Unicorn
flavour: A samurai remains such even when his saya is filled.
text:
As a Focus Effect: You may choose (now) to delay the effects of losing this duel until after the next Dynasty Phase begins.
Battle/Open: Choose your performing unbowed Unicorn Clan Personality and target another unit: Straighten it. Gain 1 Honor, or 2 Honor if you do not control the target.

name: The Slow Death
flavour: It seemed a simple cut at the time, but it would not stop bleeding. In moments, he was weakened, and then he was dead. Unfortunate, but such things happen. - Bayushi Mitsuo
text:
As a Focus Effect: After this duel ends, give its winner +3F.
Battle: Target an opposed unit: Straighten it.

flavour: No enemy is so great as to require retreat.

Battle: If any enemy units are at the current battlefield, choose your performing unbowed Mantis Clan Personality: Move him there. You may take an additional Battle action.

name: The Courtesy of the Crane
flavour: The open hand holds no weapon.

Political
As a Focus Effect: After this duel ends, if you won it, give all your provinces +2 strength.
Open: Choose your performing unbowed Crane Clan Personality: Choose another player. He may draw a card. Draw two cards.

flavour: A soul of strength knows no fear.
text:
As a Focus Effect: You may choose (now) to delay the effects of losing this duel until after the next Dynasty Phase begins.
Battle: If you control any units at the current battlefield, choose your performing Crab Clan Personality who is face-up in your provinces or discarded (not dead): Bring him into play there, paying all costs.

name: The Loyalty of the Scorpion
flavour: Absolute devotion is absolute harmony.
text:
As a Focus Effect: You may choose (now) to delay the effects of losing this duel until after the next Dynasty Phase begins.
Reaction: After an action targets your Scorpion Clan Personality, destroy your performing Scorpion Clan Personality: Negate either the bowing, movement, or destruction of the target from the action's effects.

name: Ninja Tricks
flavour: Smoke bombs and wild chases in the dark are the stuff of kabuki plays. No one seriously expects to get things done that way. - Shosuro Makiko
text:
Ninja
Reaction: After an action on a Strategy is announced, bow your performing Ninja Personality at the current battlefield: Negate the action's effects. Lose 2 Honor.

name: The Honor of the Lion
flavour: Act only with honor and all is glory.
text:
As a Focus Effect: You may choose (now) to delay the effects of losing this duel until after the next Dynasty Phase begins.
Battle/Open: Choose your performing unbowed honorable Lion Clan Personality: Permanently give him a bonus raising his PH to 4 and the ability, "Battle: Target an enemy Personality with equal or lower Personal Honor: Bow him. Gain 2 Honor."

name: The Light of Justice
flavour: You will suffer for your crimes!
text:
Imperial • Political
Battle: If any enemy units are at the current battlefield, choose your performing Magistrate Personality at home: Move him to the current battlefield. If he moved, straighten his unit. If any dishonorable Personalities are now opposing him, you may take an additional Battle action.

name: The Shadow Court
flavour: The Imperial Court is by far the most important court, but by no means the only important court. - Doji Makoto
text: Battle: Choose your performing defending Courtier and target an enemy Personality: Bow him. After the next time this turn another player's action or a battle resolution destroys your Courtier, draw a card, and choose a player, who gains or loses 2 Honor.

name: The Strength of the Spider
flavour: Conquest crushes all fear and doubt.
text:
As a Focus Effect: You may choose (now) to delay the effects of losing this duel until after the next Dynasty Phase begins.
Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Spider Clan Personality and target an enemy Personality or Follower: Destroy it if it is bowed. Reduce its Force by an amount equal to your Personality's Force. Bow it if its Force is now 0.

name: Shameful Injury
flavour: Better to die than live and become a burden upon your lord. - Tangen's Lies
text: Battle: Even if you control no units at the current battlefield, target a Personality: Negate all current and new Force bonuses and penalties on him from actions.

name: Unimpeachable Name
flavour: Do not speak ill of her. You only harm yourself.

Political
Reaction: Before the resolution of another player's action: Reduce each Honor loss from its effects by 3 (minimum 0). You may target and rehonor a dishonorable Personality.
Battle: Bow your performing Shugenja and target an enemy card: Bow it. Gain 2 Honor.

name: Dangerous Indulgence
flavour: I love Ryoko Owari...
text: Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Tactician and target a Personality with equal or lower Chi: Bow or straighten him.

name: Wall of Honor
