text: Battle: Move your performing opposed Personality home: Increase or decrease the strength of the current battlefield's province by an amount equal to the number of units on the enemy side there. Gain 2 Honor.

name: White Shore Plain
flavour: It is a place heavy with destiny.
text:
Terrain
While at the current battlefield, each of your Tacticians has the ability "Tactical Reaction: Before this battle's resolution: Give this Tactician a Force bonus equal to his Chi."
Battle: If there are no Terrains at the current battlefield: Put this card into play there.

name: Ever-Winter Copse
flavour: There are places blessed by the spirits of winter, forever touched by the preserving chill of snow and ice.
text:
Forest • Winter
When another Holding produces Gold to pay for a Nonhuman, bow this card: Produce 1 Gold.

name: Winter Sled
flavour: Is there no end to the oddities the Unicorn acquired in gaijin lands? - The Voice of the Emperor
text:
While you control a Winter card, other players' cards' effects will not negate this Personality's movement.
Reaction: After engaging, if any enemy units are at the current battlefield, bow this card: Move this Personality there.

name: Surprise Attack
flavour: The return of the Naga was welcomed by few, and feared by many.
text: Battle: Choose one or more of your performing Nonhuman Personalities at the current battlefield and target one of the enemy leader's Personalities there or at home: Create a battlefield (not associated with any province). Move all the performers and targets there.

name: Riverside Port
text:
Port • Unique
Bow this card: Produce 2 Gold.
Limited: If it is your first turn: Put one or more cards in your provinces at the bottom of your deck, refilling the provinces face-up.

name: Imperial Gift
flavour: I bear a gift for you, commander, to commemorate your service and glorious victory for the Empress.
text:
Imperial • Unique
Gain 2 Honor and search your Fate deck for an Item, show it, and put it into your hand.

name: Hida's Guidance - exp
flavour: The Little Bear carries his great-grandfather's spirit.
text:
Kami • Experienced • Unique
Before the first straightening each battle of a Personality whose enemy leader is a Crab Clan player: Negate that straightening.
Battle: If you are a Crab Clan player, discard this card and target a Personality: Bow him. Bow his unit if he is attacking.

name: Doji's Guidance - exp
flavour: Makoto, the Smiling Blade, is graceful, calm and focused in court and battle.
text:
Kami • Experienced • Unique
Crane Clan players may take the rulebook Favor Political Battle action even if they control no units at the current battlefield.
Open: If you are a Crane Clan player, discard this card: Put a non-Unique Strategy with a Political ability in your discard pile into your hand.

name: Togashi's Guidance - exp
flavour: The Laughing Dragon balances the Togashi and Mirumoto.
text:
Kami • Experienced • Unique
Dragon Clan players' maximum hand size is increased by two.
Battle/Open: If you are a Dragon Clan player, discard this card: You may either put a Ring in your hand into play, or search your discard pile, then Fate deck, for a Ring and put it into your hand.

name: Akodo's Guidance - exp
flavour: The Steel Lion is new to the Championship, but her swordsmanship and tactical prowess are reminiscent of Akodo One-Eye.
text:
Kami • Experienced • Unique
Lion Clan players may target defending enemy units with the rulebook Favor Political Battle action.
Battle: If you are a Lion Clan player, discard this card and choose your performing Personality: Melee 4 Attack.

name: Yoritomo's Guidance - exp
flavour: The Growing Storm's reign shall shake the Empire.
text:
Kami • Experienced • Unique
After engaging, if the Attacker is a Mantis Clan player: Reduce the current battlefield's province's strength to 5.
Limited: If you are a Mantis Clan player, discard this card and target your discarded Port holding: Put it into play (bowed), paying all costs but paying 2 less Gold.

name: Shiba's Guidance - exp
flavour: The Soul of Shiba has been Tsukimi's constant companion for decades.
text:
Kami • Experienced • Unique
After a battle resolution ends in which a Phoenix Clan player destroyed one or more provinces or enemy cards: He draws a card.
Battle/Open: If you are a Phoenix Clan player, discard this card: Put a non-Unique Spell or Kiho in your discard pile into your hand.

name: Bayushi's Guidance - exp
flavour: Nitoshi, the Poison Mask, strikes in the night against the Empire's enemies.
text:
Kami • Experienced • Unique
After a player's turn begins, if he is Scorpion Clan: Each other player loses 1 Honor.
Open: If you are a Scorpion Clan player, discard this card and target one or more face-up Personalities in provinces: Put each one at the bottom of its owner's deck in any order. Refill the provinces face-up.

name: Daigotsu's Guidance
flavour: Father... I wait. I will lead our people to victory.
text:
Unique
After a Celestial enters play (including this one): Discard all Kami Celestials in play.
Battle: If you are a Spider Clan player, discard this card and target an enemy unit: Destroy all bowed cards in it. Bow it.

name: Shinjo's Guidance - exp
flavour: They say I am Shinjo reborn. Why do I not feel different? - Moto Naleesh
text:
Kami • Experienced • Unique
Unicorn Clan Personalities have +1F while they have an attachment.
Limited: Discard this card: Search your discard pile, then Dynasty deck, for Moto Naleesh and put her into one of your provinces, face-up, discarding the card that was there.

name: Benefices of the Emperor
flavour: Iweko Setai often represents his wife in court.
text:
Imperial • Unique
Each player in turn order starting with you may choose a card in his hand. Discard all chosen cards. If exactly one player's card has the lowest Focus Value of all those cards, he gains a province to the left of his leftmost province. If exactly one player's card has the highest Focus Value of all those cards, permanantly increase his maximum hand size by three, and he draws three cards.

name: Naoharu's Gift
flavour: Naoharu is long since gone, but his lessons endure for a new generation to learn. - Doji Shunya
text:
Winter • Unique
Show a card in your hand to another player. You offer it as a gift. He may put it in his hand; if he does, you gain Honor equal to its base Focus Value. If you showed a card and he did not put it in his hand, discard the card and draw 2 cards.

name: Moon and Sun
flavour: Onnotangu and Amaterasu gave way to Hitomi and Yakamo, who gave way to the Obsidian Moon and the Jade Sun. The Heavens are complete and their blessings are showered upon the mortal realm. - Matsu Kasei
text:
Unique
Each player may shuffle an Event in his discard pile into his deck.

name: Successful Bounty
flavour: Good day, Champion. I am pleased to surrender this fugitive to you for justice. I believe there is a stipend for his capture?
text:
Unique
Until your Events Phase three turns from now begins, after each time a Personality opposing a Magistrate or Courtier becomes dishonorable from an action, the Personality's controller loses 2 Honor.

name: Suspicions
flavour: The greatest dramas always leave the matter of guilt or innocence slightly ambivalent. Is it any surprise the Scorpion feature prominently in so many? - Bayushi Hurunayi
text:
Unique
Until the game ends, before each of your Events Phases ends, each player in turn order starting with you loses 1 Honor.

name: Alter History
flavour: Ambitious men might succub to temptation. Our duty is to record without bias. We alone can do so. - Miya Shoin
text:
Unique
After the next time this game you destroy a province as the Attacker, the Defender loses 5 Honor. If this loss brings him below his starting Family Honor, then until the game ends, he may ignore Honor Requirements when bringing Personalities into play.

name: Rebuilding the Empire
flavour: The end of an era, the beginning of another.
text:
Unique
Any player with three or fewer provinces may gain a province to the right of his rightmost province. Each player who gained a province from this has his Family Honor lowered to its starting value, and he may not declare an attack until your next turn begins. This Honor loss will not be negated or given to another player instead.

name: Venerable Master
flavour: A generation of warriors has grown up never knowing war. How long can this last? How long should it last? - Kuronada
text:
Retainer
Bow this card: Produce 2 Gold.
Open: Bow and destroy this card, and pay 2 Gold: Create a 3F/3C/3PH Samurai Personality with your Clan alignment.

name: Traveling Peddler
flavour: They are poor, only one step above a beggar. They travel everywhere, and no samurai ever gives them a second thought. They are perfect, really. - Yasuki Jinn-Kuen
text:
Singular
Bow this card: Produce 2 Gold.
Limited: Bow this card and pay 3 Gold: Draw a card.

name: Luxurious Silk
flavour: A samurai's appearance is as clear as a war-fan's signal, for those who know how to read it. A vain man and a dutiful one will both choose their clothes with care, but the result is far different. Vice cannot be hidden, and virtue will find a way to be heard. - Kakita Hideo
text:
Bow this card: Produce 2 Gold.
Reaction: Even if this card is bowed, when paying for an action: Produce 2 Gold.

name: Public Records
flavour: The world will never lack for stories. Even something as mundane as a barley harvest can generate a winter's worth of tales, if the teller knows his craft. - Matsu Kasei
text:
Singular
Bow this card: Produce 2 Gold.
Limited: Bow this card: Look at the top three cards of your Fate deck. Put them back in any order.

name: Well-Tended Farm
flavour: Being concerned with money is considered crass, but no one listens to a poor man. When push comes to shove, wealth creates its own respectability. - Yasuki Jekku
text:
Farm
Bow this card: Produce 1 Gold.
Limited: Bow this card: Gain 1 Honor.

name: Hiruma Nitani
flavour: With the Spider, we clutch a serpent to our breast. Our vigil must never waver. Their ancestors can never become ours.
text:

Crab Clan • Samurai • Siege • Soul of Kaiu Seison

name: Asahina Keigo
flavour: I leave the worries over the Second City and its governor to the Doji. My duty is to keep our temples in good repair.
text:
Crane Clan • Air • Shugenja • Soul of Asahina Yoshino

name: Doji Genshin
flavour: They think I will not be able to discover who is guilty. They think I will not be able to find them. They think I can be frightened or bought off. They think they can best me in a duel.
text: Crane Clan • Samurai • Duelist • Magistrate

name: Kakita Seishi
flavour: Her songs are a wonder and a delight. She moves the hearts and uplifts the souls of all who hear her. - Isawa Kimi
text:
Crane Clan • Artisan • Soul of Kakita Ariteko
Open: Bow Seishi and target a dishonorable Personality: Rehonor him.

name: Asahina Kitiaru
flavour: The Asahina have a tradition of fulfilling a number of roles. Those without the gift of the kami often find themselves in court. - Doji Makoto
text:
Crane Clan • Courtier • Samurai • Unique • Soul of Konetsu
Political Open: Target a Personality: Kitiaru copies one of his Political abilities that does not itself copy abilities.

name: Kitsuki Daisuke
flavour: By questioning my evidence, you question my methods. By questioning my methods, you question my school. By questioning my school, you question my honor. I demand an opportunity to respond to your slight.
text:
Dragon Clan • Courtier • Duelist • Magistrate
Iaijutsu Battle: Target an enemy Personality: Daisuke duels him. Move the duel's loser home; if he is dishonorable, this movement will not be negated.

flavour: The years may have robbed me of my speed, but my technique is as crisp as ever.
text:
Dragon Clan • Samurai • Duelist • Experienced • Loyal • Unique

name: Mirumoto Gobashi
flavour: Every year, I have the honor of training a new crop of students. Every year, I have the duty to teach them to avoid the mistakes their predecessors have made. It is a joy and a burden, and I revel in both. - The Journal of Kitsuki Fusami
text: Dragon Clan • Samurai • Kensai • Soul of Mirumoto Ino

name: Tamori Tomaru
flavour: As always, they insist that their paths are their own, and that no others are fit to judge their conduct. Their secrecy and eccentricity raise unsettling questions. - Isawa Mitsuko
text: Dragon Clan • Earth • Shugenja • Alchemist

name: Tsai-tsu
flavour: Under Iweko I, the Empire prospered. The heavens showered their blessings upon Rokugan, in ways both obvious and subtle. - The writings of Miya Shoin
text: Dragon Clan • Nonhuman • Ryu • Cavalry • Tactician

name: Akodo Kisho
flavour: Somewhere beyond the Empire, there is a threat such as we have never known. Pushing forward into the Colonies increases the risk of a premature conflict with the Yodotai, and we must not permit that to happen.
text: Lion Clan • Samurai • Commander • Paragon • Soul of Akodo Dosei

name: Ikoma Natsu
flavour: I have studied my namesake and learned much about out former enemy. If the Unicorn ever march on Rokugan again, I will be ready.
text:
Lion Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Soul of Ikoma Otemi
Natsu will not be controlled by a Unicorn Clan player.

name: Akodo Kano
flavour: Duty is not always as it seems. There are many ways to serve.
text:
Lion Clan • Samurai • Tactician • Unique • Master Tactician • Soul of Kitsu Motso

Battle: Bow Kano and destroy a Master token on him: Take two additional Battle actions.

name: Akodo Suoh
flavour: To understand war, you must understand your enemy. To understand your enemy, you must understand yourself. To understand yourself, you must understand the world.
text: Lion Clan • Samurai • Tactician • Soul of Akodo Shunori

name: Yoritomo Doho
flavour: Doho traveled far and wide, across the Colonies and mainland Rokugan. He found the first clue in a Crab port city. A small token, embossed with the Kolat insignia.
text: Mantis Clan • Samurai • Naval • Magistrate

name: Kitsune Denhei
flavour: The souls of those slain in the Colonies will not rest until they have slaughtered the guilty. I will provide them their solace.
text:
Mantis Clan • Earth • Shugenja

name: Unmei
flavour: Do you require the wisdom of ten lifetimes, child?

Mantis Clan • Nonhuman • Shapeshifter • Spirit • Unique

name: Asako Nobunori
flavour: Fire is a riddle of itself. It destroys so to maintain its life, and in its death it clears the way for new life. And now I will clear the way to your new life.
text:
Phoenix Clan • Fire • Monk • Henshin
Battle: Melee 4 Attack that you may compare against base Force if the target has no attachments.

name: Asako Rinshi
flavour: You will answer my questions. You will answer them quickly and you will answer them completely. These are Phoenix lands, and we do not tolerate the stench of corruption here.
text: Phoenix Clan • Air • Shugenja • Inquisitor • Magistrate

name: Asako Ume
flavour: She is beautiful, impulsive, brilliant. Do not make mistakes around her. In fact, try nothing around her at all. - Bayushi Nitoshi
text:
Phoenix Clan • Fire • Shugenja • Soul of Isawa Furiko
Ume has +1F while she has a Spell.
Battle: Ranged 4 Attack.

name: Shiba Kataken
flavour: Stay here, my lord, and I will clear the way for you.
text:
Phoenix Clan • Samurai • Duelist • Yojimbo • Soul of Shiba Goto
Iaijutsu Battle: Target an enemy card without attachments: Bow it.

name: Shosuro Kameyoi
flavour: The Scorpion thrive on weakness and vice. They enjoy nothing more than bringing ruin upon the righteous. - Akodo Kane
text:
Scorpion Clan • Courtier • Seductress • Loyal
Political Limited: Target a Personality: If he is dishonorable, his controller loses 1 Honor, or 2 Honor if his base Personal Honor is 3 or greater. Dishonor him.

Scorpion Clan • Courtier• Unique • Soul of Bayushi Goshiu Experienced 3

name: Bayushi Yasashiku
flavour: He trained with the Unicorn, gained their trust and became their brother. He loves them as his family, but will betray them in an instant if it is required of him. It is glorious, to be a Scorpion. - Shosuro Kameyoi
text: Scorpion Clan • Samurai • Cavalry • Tactician • Soul of Bayushi Himaru

name: Shosuro Tanzaki
flavour: See this blade? It is now yours, at considerable cost to the clan. See to it that our efforts are not wasted.
text:
Scorpion Clan • Courtier
Political Open: Target another Personality: Give him +4F.

name: Shosuro Koshiba
flavour: Testimony from those high in station eclipses all other forms of proof. Guilt or innocence often hinge on the words of those in power.
text: Scorpion Clan • Samurai • Magistrate

name: Ninube Onchi
flavour: The master has commanded this ruin become a Shadow's Lair. Let our work begin.
text:
Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Ninja • Shugenja • Cavalry

Open: Target a Personality: Remove one of his abilities (until the turn ends).

name: Goju Oyoto
flavour: In the Empire, or even the Second City, he would be killed on sight. Here in the jungle, he has his uses. The other clans do not presume to instruct us in our domain. - Daigotsu Aya

Spider Clan • Shadowlands • Ninja • Shugenja • Soul of Goju Utsuei

Battle: Target an attachment: Destroy it.
Battle: Target an enemy Personality with fewer Weapons: Destroy him.

text: Unicorn Clan • Samurai • Battle Maiden • Cavalry • Paragon • Soul of Utaku Fusae

Monk • Unique • Soul of Yodin

Singular

Siege • Unique

text:
Air • Unique

Battle/Open: Target your bowed Personality: Straighten him. Gain 1 Honor.

Earth • Unique

Scout • Unique

Void • Unique

Shadowlands • Ninja • Unique

flavour: Our Champion leads us, and the Khan marshals our armies. We protect both.

Cavalry • Unique

Shadowlands • Nonhuman • Spirit

Battle Maiden • Cavalry

flavour: A well forged blade will last through countless battles, never failing its bearer in times of need.
text:
Weapon

flavour: Commonly used by magistrates to apprehend suspects, they are ideally suited to disarm foes.
text:
Weapon
Battle: Bow this card and target an enemy card without a Weapon or Armor: Bow it.

text:
Armor

Negate any destruction of this card, except for its Personality being destroyed.

name: Kensai's Blade
flavour: My rivals call katanas works of art. They are wrong. Katanas are tools of killing. - Lord Mirumoto
text:
Weapon

Weapon

Ritual

Earth

Maho

name: Summon Swamp Spirits
flavour: Mindless, foul, and numerous. Do not take the minions summoned by tsukai lightly. - Isawa Mitsuko
text:
Maho
Limited: Bow this Shugenja and target your Personality: Create a 1F Shadowlands • Nonhuman • Spirit • Swamp Spirit Follower and attach it to him.

flavour: Know that the Heavens themselves support this endeavor. - Voice of the Emperor
text:
Kami

Battle: Bow this card and target one or two Samurai: Give each of them a Force bonus equal to this Shugenja's Chi.

name: Fields of Mercy

Terrain

Battle: If there are no Terrains in play at the current battlefield: Put this card into play there.

name: A Time for Mortal Men
flavour: The Heavens approve of the new Iweko line, yet they do not interfere.
text: Battle/Open: Destroy your performing Ancestor and target your Personality: Give him +3F.

name: A Paragon's Strength
flavour: Such a weak technique could never strike me down. Try again when you are serious, boy.
text:
Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Paragon: Ranged Attack with strength equal to his Force. Lose 4 Honor.
Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Paragon and target an enemy Personality with equal or lower Personal Honor: Move him home. Gain 2 Honor.

name: A Pure Stroke
flavour: Kakita Han spent five years creating three perfect blades. One he kept by his side. One he gave to his betrothed. The last was stolen from his home. He will not set aside his vengeance until it is returned to him.
text: Battle/Open: Target a Weapon: Raise its Force and Chi modifiers to twice its base Force and Chi modifiers (this does not affect negative base modifiers).

name: Aramoro's Promise
flavour: We swore to fight in the shadows to protect the Empire. We continue to do so, even when the Throne accepts the darkness into our midst.
text:
Ninja
Limited: Choose your performing Saboteur or Ninja Personality: Discard a Dynasty card in a province. Lose 2 Honor.

name: Banish All Doubt
flavour: The Lion Clan Champion's recent ascension - and her brother's refusal of the position - has shaken her Clan. Gossips whisper that they may never recover under her rule.
text:
Tactical
Limited: Choose your performing unbowed Tactician: Look at the top four cards of your Fate deck. Put one of them in your hand and put the other three on the bottom of your deck in any order.

name: Caught Unawares
flavour: Where did they come from? Quick! Move the heavy infantry to our flanks!
text:

Battle: Target an enemy card with no unbowed attachments. Bow it.

name: Deadly Orders
flavour: This is an ogre, boys! You have three chances to kill it with your unit. Now attack it before it destroys any tactics you can make!
text: Battle: Choose your performing Commander and target your Follower: Give it a Force bonus equal to twice its current Force. After this battle's resolution, destroy the Follower.

name: Chikushudo's Trickery
text:
Earth • Forest

text: Reaction: After another player's action targets one or more of your Personalities: Negate their bowing from the action's effects.

name: Control the Field
flavour: The Battle Maidens will never forget the Battle of Living Flames. They were outmaneuvered and overwhelmed by a smaller force. The shame will never leave them, though it has long passed into memory for the rest of the Empire.
text: Battle: Choose your performing Personality with Scout, Tactician, or 3 or higher Chi, and target a Terrain: Destroy it. You may take an additional Battle action to play a Terrain.

name: Duel of Serpents
flavour: Those few Naga who remained awake waged a desperate war for survival against the castoffs of their own people.
text:

Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Nonhuman or Spirit and target an enemy card without attachments: Bow it.

text: Open: Shuffle your hand into your Fate deck: Draw a number of cards equal to the number you shuffled in.

text: Open: Target a Personality: Bow or straighten him.

name: Heavily Engaged
flavour: Prolonged conflict fatigues even the most stalwart of bushi.
text: Battle: Even if you control no units at the current battlefield: Each player targets an unbowed Personality he controls there, if possible. Bow all targets.

name: Oyo's Second Lesson
flavour: The wisdom of the Henshin often outlasts their mortal bodies.
text:
Kiho
Battle/Open: Choose your performing dead Henshin and target your Personality: Your Henshin is reborn. Overlay him onto your Personality. Draw a card. You may take an additional action.

Iaijutsu • Political

Void

Kiho

text:

Limited: Choose your performing unbowed non-Duelist Courtier Personality, target a Personality with equal or lower Personal Honor, and discard the Imperial Favor: Destroy a non-Unique card in his unit without attachments. Dishonor him (if he is still in play).

name: A Cleansing Breath
flavour: We do not know why the Lion have attacked the Spider encampments with our advisors. They have brought no testimony, levied no charges. While we find the truth of the matter, we cannot simply allow this to go unanswered. - Mirumoto Kojinrue
text: Battle/Open: Target your Personality at any location: He centers himself. Negate other players' cards' effects that prevent him assigning, moving or performing actions. If he is a Kensai, straighten his unit.

name: Shifting Waves
flavour: In one moment, the monk was on her feet, all traces of serenity replaced by a fury I would never thought her capable of.
text:
Kiho
Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Henshin and target a Personality: Switch the target's Force and Chi.

name: Kitsuki Judgment
flavour: It appears the Lion are not baseless in their claims, Daigotsu-san. There will be repercussions to both clans for the Dragon who have died over this dispute.
text:
Political
Limited: Choose your performing unbowed Magistrate, target a Human Personality, and pay Gold equal to his unit's total Gold Cost, +8 unless he is dishonorable, Kolat, Ninja, or Shadowlands: He commits seppuku.

name: Harmony
flavour: It is a simple truth that so many seekers would ignore - we do not search for enlightenment. We are enlightened; we simply do not realize it. - Yung
text:
Void • Kiho
Open: Choose your performing Monk: Permanently give him the trait, "You may bow this card instead of bowing a Ring to pay a cost."

name: Martyr's Call
flavour: They are powerful, but they are merely flesh. I will show you!
text: Battle/Open: Destroy your performing Paragon and target one or two of your other Personalities: Give them +3F and Stalwart (Stalwart cards negate their first bowing each turn by other players' cards).

name: Without Mercy
flavour: Why are you reaching for this, Kakita-san? I was told your school only requires one strike. - Yoritomo Hiromi
text:
Dark Virtue • Determination
Reaction: After a Battle action performed by your Samurai Personality resolves, if the action did not target an enemy card: Take an additional Battle action.

name: Nocturnal Attack
flavour: I wish to speak to the disgraceful abomination that calls itself the Shadow Dragon. Kill anyone you must to make this happen. - Bayushi Kazutoshi
text:
Ninja
Limited: Bow your performing Ninja Personality: The option to create an Attack Phase comes after the Dynasty Phase this turn.

name: Ready the Defenses
flavour: We have little information on their exact strength, but we must assume it is a complete Imperial Legion and plan accordingly. - Akodo Chiyo
text: Open: Choose your performing Personality and target a province: While at the province's battlefields, other players' Personalities and Followers have -1F and, if your performer is a Tactician, your Personalities and Followers there have +1F.

name: Recruitment Effort
flavour: The Mantis have assets we cannot counter through politics, to be sure, but there is very little that cannot be countered with unlimited wealth. - Doji Iza
text: Open: Destroy your target non-Unique Holding: Create a 3F/3C/2PH Samurai Personality.

name: Scandalous Gossip
flavour: They say the Imperials were dispatched by the Empress herself in order to rein in the Governor! Can you imagine such a thing?
text:
Political
Open: If (and only if) this card is in your discard pile, remove it from the game and target a player: He must choose and bow one of his unbowed Personalities, if possible. Gain 1 Honor.

name: Ambush Tactics
flavour: With the government of the Colonies distracted by the events at the Second City, skirmishes among the Great Clans became increasingly frequent, and increasingly deadly.
text:
Recon
Battle: Bow your performing Personality: Ranged 3 Attack with +2 strength if your performer is a Scout. You may move him home.

name: Imperial Deployment
flavour: Go and bring law to the lawless. - Utaku Ji-Yun
text:
Imperial
Open: Choose your performing Personality: The Empress dispatches him to the Colonies. Negate other players' cards' effects that prevent him assigning. After the next time this turn an attack is declared, straighten his unit.

name: Trusting Instinct
flavour: Your belly can perceive things your mind cannot. It can tell you how to act, even before the threat has appeared. A samurai trusts his belly. This is called 'Haragei.' - Mirumoto's "Niten"
text:
Reaction: After a Ranged or Melee attack is targeted: Give it -2 strength.
Battle: Choose your performing Personality: Move him to a battlefield where he would be opposed.

name: Tactical Sacrifice
flavour: There comes a time when the value of a vassal must be weighed against the value of victory. This is the unfortunate reality of war. - Akodo's Leadership
text: Limited: Choose your performing unbowed Commander, destroy his performing Follower, and target a Follower, or Personality without attachments, with Gold Cost equal to or less than twice your Follower's Gold Cost: Destroy the target.

name: Improper Papers
flavour: A thousand pardons, but it appears these papers are inadequate to pass the border.
text: Reaction: Before an action resolves, target a Personality: Negate his movement from the action's effects.

name: The Last Move
flavour: For all their perceived faults, many still underestimate the lengths of a Scorpion's devotion.
text:
Political
Battle: Destroy your performing unbowed Courtier and target an enemy Personality: Dishonor him. You may target and destroy a card without attachments in his unit.

name: Spiritual Coelescence
flavour: All things echo in ways man cannot perceive.
text: Battle/Open: Destroy your performing Spirit Personality and target another Spirit Personality: Give it a permanent Force bonus equal to the performer's Force. It permanently copies the performer's abilities which do not themselves copy abilities. You may take an additional action.

name: Avenging the Fallen
flavour: An oath to avenge fallen comrades is gravely serious. Nothing else can exist in the warrior's mind once the promise is spoken. A samurai's word and deed are as one.
text: Battle: Choose your performing Personality: Straighten him. If another player's Battle action has destroyed one of your Personalities this battle, negate the performer's next destruction from cards' effects (this turn).

name: The Passing of Tradition
flavour: May the ways of our ancestors live on in you.
text:
Battle/Open: Choose your performing Personality and target your Personality: The performer permanently copies a keyword from the target, other than Courtier, Samurai, or Shugenja.
Limited: Target your discarded Personality: Put him into ones of your provinces (face-up) discarding the card currently there.

name: In the Right
flavour: The only excuse the Mantis have for their attacks is greed for power and plunder, the Crane said. "What else would you expect?"
text:
Political
Battle: Bow your performing Courtier at any location and target one or more attacking cards, up to half your Courtier's Chi, rounded down: Bow the targets.

name: Forgotten Teachings
flavour: The young learn too late that they ought to learn from the past. - Moto Taha
text: Open: Target another player's Sensei Personality: Remove all traits and abilities from him (this turn).

name: Eye of the Sword
flavour: Victory in a duel is the purest kind. - Doji Genshin
text:
Iaijutsu
Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Duelist and target an enemy Personality: Your Personality duels the target. Give the winner two +1F tokens. Destroy the duel's loser.

name: Spoils of Exploration
flavour: Surely my lord will not notice if a few baubles go missing.
text:
Kata
After a battle resolution ends in which you destroyed an army or province: Draw a card.
Limited: Put this card into play. Discard all your other Kata in play.

name: Forest Cover
flavour: Very satisfying when they realize we were there all along.
text:
Recon
Reaction: After engaging, choose your performing Scout Personality at the current battlefield: You have Reconnaissance there. You may attach a Follower to him from your hand or discard pile, paying all costs. If you did, draw an additional card during your next End Phase.

name: Frozen in Place
flavour: It's amusing, the look they get when it dawns on them that the only way to escape justice is to grow wings. - Hiruma Akio
text: Battle/Open: Target a Personality: Give him -3F/-1C.

name: Pierce the Tapestry
text:
Kiho • Void
You may include up to seven copies of this card in your deck.
Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Monk and target an enemy Personality or Follower: Give it -3F. If it has no attachments and you have played two or more other Pierce the Tapestry this battle, destroy it. If this did not destroy it, you may take an additional Battle action to play a Pierce the Tapestry.

name: Harbor of Kalani's Landing
flavour: We will return every fire to them tenfold. - Moshi Rukia
text:
Port • Terrain
Negate Personalities' movement to or from this battlefield.
Battle: If there is no Terrain in play at the current battlefield: Put this card into play there. You may take an additional Battle action.

name: Journey's End Keep - exp
text:
Imperial • Experienced
"Imperial" is a Clan alignment, and it is your Clan alignment. You may not buy Personalities with Clan discount if Imperial is their only Clan alignment. If no other player has an Imperial Stronghold, you begin the game with the Imperial Favor. This card does not produce Gold when paying for Personalities.

name: Kenro-ji-jin's Bounty
flavour: Few samurai regularly pay homage to the Fortune of Soil, but all should. His largesse permits our very survival. - Agasha Kurou
text:
Fortune • Unique
Reaction: When paying for a Farm: Produce 1 Gold.
Limited: Discard this card: Your Farms produce 1 additional Gold when they bow to produce Gold (this turn).

name: Diplomacy Talks
flavour: The Crane are masters of diplomacy, but have encountered few foes as recalcitrant as the Mantis. Still, in the aftermath of the battle, even the Mantis desired peace. - Asako Kikugoro
text:
Unique
Until your next turn begins, after each time a player creates an Attack Phase, destroy his rightmost province.

name: Colonial Farm
flavour: As with the Empire, the Colonies depend upon them.
text:
Farm
Enters play paying 1 less Gold if you are a Lion Clan player.
Bow this card: Produce 5 Gold.
Limited: Bow this card and target your Personality: Create a 1F Ashigaru Follower and attach it to him.

name: Seppun Barru
flavour: The commander has entrusted to me the safe-keeping of Journey's End City and the supply chain that ensures the Imperial Legion is prepared for anything. I will do precisely that.
text:
Imperial • Samurai • Commander
Battle: Give your Followers in Barru's army +1F.

name: Fusako
flavour: My mother once walked the path of the wave man. She came to serve the Dragon, and was a great hero. I shall walk her path again, and my greatness shall eclipse even hers.
text:
Ronin • Samurai • Duelist • Unique
Iaijutsu Limited: Target another player's Personality: Fusako challenges the target. His controller may bow him; if he is now bowed, he may refuse the duel. Destroy the duel's loser.

name: Renewed Lands
flavour: I do not understand. A year ago this land was dead. - Matsu Koyama
text: After a Farm Holding enters play from this province: Give it a +1 Gold Production token and refill this province face-up.

name: Daifuke
flavour: Self-righteous buffoon! Do you think your ridiculous philosophy makes you a better man? A better warrior? I will see your innards in the dirt!
text: Open: Target another player's Follower or Personality: Switch the target's and this card's Force.

name: Furugaro
flavour: I know my path is true. Your path is of no concern to me. Insist upon confronting me, and you shall be shattered on the mountain of my certainty.
text:
Fudo
Limited: Destroy this card and target Fudo: Give him two Charging tokens.

name: Peace Treaty
flavour: I want to know the truth behind this Battle of Ten Thousand Martyrs. If that means peace, then so be it. - Yoritomo Hiromi
text: Limited: If there are more than two players, choose a player. He may choose to sign a peace treaty with you. If he chose this, then until your next Events Phase begins, neither of you may declare an attack against, or ally against, the other. If he did not choose this, you gain 3 Honor and he loses 3 Honor.

name: Sanctuary of the Waves
flavour: The sea is a thing of great destructive power, but also great mercy and salvation. - Asako Chukage
text:
Water
Battle: Bow this card and target this Shugenja, or, if this Shugenja is Water, you may target another of your Personalities: Move the target to the current battlefield if he would be opposed there. Straighten him if he moved.

name: Interrogation
flavour: We know you were involved in the blighting of our lands, Spider. That you will not confess is meaningless. Now we have a much more important question, and one you will answer: what weapon brought about this renewal?
text:
Reaction: Before another player's action resolves: Negate its effects that bow, destroy, or discard your Holdings, Regions, or Terrains in play.
Open: Pay 2 Gold: Draw a card.

name: Lantern of Revelation
flavour: It sees perfectly in any darkness, revealing all that its light falls upon. I find it a wretched inconvenience and would see it destroyed. - Shosuro Hawado
text:
Nemuranai
Limited: Look at the top card of one of your decks. You may put it at the bottom.

name: Summon Fushicho
flavour: In times of great peril, it can be quite an advantage to hold the favor of the Celestial Heavens and its denizens.
text: Limited: Bow this Shugenja and destroy this card: Search your Fate deck for an Item, show it, and put it in your hand.

name: Fudo's Assurances
flavour: Seek your own path. Ignore the philosophies thrust upon you by others. Only you can choose that which is right for you. - The writings of Fudo
text:
Fudo • Unique
Battle/Open: Straighten a Ring.
Open: If you control five Fudo Rings that last entered play by their own text, destroy a Province.

name: Hantei's Guidance
flavour: The resolve of Rokugan's first Emperor was unshakable.
text:
Kami • Unique
The rulebook's Favor Political Battle action has Absent for you, and you may target any Personality with it. (Absent actions can be taken without presence.)
Political Interrupt: Discard this Celestial. Negate a Political action.

name: P'an Ku's Madness
flavour:
Power of Heaven
Essence of the mortal world
All lost to madness.
text:
Dragon • Unique
Limited: Give a target card a Madness token.
Open: Discard this Celestial. A target Personality with a Madness token cannot attack or defend.

name: The Madness Spreads
flavour: Even in the simplest of activities, the madness began to manifest itself among those who seemed most unlikely...
text:
Unique
Limited: Until your second turn from now begins, once per turn, you may take a Limited action on a Strategy as an Open action.

name: Dark Audience
flavour: With the truth behind the Blood revealed, the other clans sent their finest to petition the Spider for its use.
text:
Unique
Limited: Search your Fate deck for two attachments with different titles. Show them. Another player chooses one of them and removes it from the game. Put the other attachment in your hand.

name: Rampant Paranoia
flavour: Commander, how can we know if those outside the gates are corrupted?
text: Limited: Until your next turn begins, other players' cards will not destroy your Personalities in a defending army.

name: Riot in the Second City
flavour: In the year 1199, according to the Isawa calendar, the previously unseen influence of the mad dragon, P'an Ku, reached into the hearts of many within the Colonies, and the result was madness and suffering on an undreamt of scale.
text:
Unique
Limited: Each player targets and bows an unbowed Samurai.

name: The Empire's Foe Exposed
flavour: Doji Hakuseki looked upon the face of the being that had threatened her Empire, and she felt the sin of hate in her heart.
text:
Unique
Limited: Target two Unique Personalities in play, exactly one of which is yours. Your Personality challenges the other Personality. Destroy the duel's loser.

name: An End to Hostilities
flavour: With the news of P'an Ku's involvement, the Governor and the Commander agreed to set aside their conflict in the interest of a greater threat.
text:
Unique
Limited: Until the game ends, each player draws two cards instead of one at the end of his turn if he put no other cards in his hand that turn.

name: The Second Battle of Beiden Pass
flavour: There are times in history when madness has inspired incredible victories, Ikoma Natsu said. "How am I to feel about this?"
text:
Unique
Limited: Until the game ends, this Province does not hold Dynasty cards and has +10 Province Strength.

name: An Empire of Madness
flavour: Through the haze and the veil of time, the magistrates beheld a terrible sight... a land ruled by fear and madness.
text:
Unique
Until the game ends, each player has the ability, "Open: Your target Personality with a Madness token commits Seppuku" and any player who ends his turn with 20 or more Madness tokens on his Personalities loses the game.

name: False Ring of Fire
flavour: Passion.
text:
Fire • Fudo • Unique
Does not count towards an Enlightenment Victory.
Open: If your maximum hand size is 10 or more, put this Ring into play and lose 2 Honor.
Interrupt, [BOW]: Reduce all Honor gains and losses from an action by 2.

name: Border Keep - exp2
flavour: As the madness grew, the clans secured their borders for fear that it would consume them all.
text:
Experienced 2 • Unique
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold, or 3 Gold if paying for a Holding.
Limited: Once or twice during your first turn (only), put one or more cards in your Provinces at the bottom of your deck, refilling them face-up.

name: Recruitment Station
flavour: Weapons, armor, maps, rations... whatever you require, it can be found here. Use it sparingly, that those who come after might make use of it as well.
text:
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold.
Battle/Open, [PAY *], [BOW]: Equip a Follower, paying 2 less Gold.

name: Colonial Dojo
flavour: My Lion brothers, others may have mocked us for the hours we spent in the dojo. But it was those lessons, that strength, that brotherhood, from which we have gained the strength to resist this madness. Now to the streets! And let us bring order to the city once more!
text: [BOW]: When paying for a non-Unique Samurai, he enters play for 0 Gold.

name: Questionable Merchant
flavour: This draught will protect you from the unfortunate business of the day, my friend. There may be some ill effects, yes, but you will not go mad. That's something, isn't it?
text:
Retainer
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold.
Battle: Move a target attacking Personality home. Destroy this Holding.

name: Fudoist Advisor
flavour: Even heretics have their uses.
text:
Fudo • Retainer • Kharmic
(Limited, [PAY 2]: Discard a Kharmic card from your Province and refill it face-up.)
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold.
Limited,[BOW]: Destroy a Madness token.

name: Temple of Madness
flavour: You worship your gods, samurai, and I shall worship mine. Look at the Colonies and ask yourself, which is more powerful? - Takujin
text:
Temple
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold.
Limited, [BOW]: Give a target card a Madness token.

name: Suikihime's Chambers
flavour: It has briefly been my prison, perhaps, but this plague of madness shall see it once again my throne. - Otomo Suikihime
text:
Imperial
[BOW]: Produce 2 Gold, or 4 Gold if paying for a Unique Personality.
Limited, [BOW]: Gain 1 Honor.

name: Hida O-Ushi - inexp
flavour: My grandmother was beautiful and powerful, feared and yet desired by all who knew her. Would that I could have known her, to rejoice in such a perfect daughter of Hida. - Hida Kisada
text:
Crab Clan • Bully • Samurai • Inexperienced • Loyal • Unique
Limited: Bow a target Personality with lower Force.

name: Hiruma Nikaru, the Flesh Eater
flavour: Tear your flesh! Drink your bones! Everything about honor is a lie, and I will show you the truth in pain and suffering!
text:
Crab Clan • Berserker • Fallen • Experienced 2 • Unique
After Nikaru enters play, lose 3 Honor.
Nikaru uses his printed Force as his duel stat.

name: Kuni Renyu - exp2
flavour: This land is a festering cesspool. I would say let the madness claim it, but that it might threaten the Empire.

Crab Clan • Daimyo • Earth • Jade • Magistrate • Witch Hunter • Experienced 2 • Loyal • Shugenja • Unique

Earth Battle: Bow a target enemy card with Shadowlands or without attachments.

name: Hiruma Ogata
flavour: You want to see it?! You want to see the darkness we have held at bay?!
text:
Crab Clan • Fallen • Samurai • Scout
After Ogata enters play, lose 2 Honor.
Ogata has +1F for each opposing Madness token.

name: Yasuki Tono - exp
flavour:
Your methods are disgraceful, Renyu sneered.

"I do only what I must, to prove worthy of a woman I do not deserve," Tono countered.
text:
Crab Clan • Courtier • Merchant • Experienced • Unique
Open, [BOW]: Straighten a target Holding or Shosuro Kameyoi.

name: Doji Hakuseki - exp3
flavour: At last I know my enemy.
text:
Crane Clan • First Magistrate • Imperial • Magistrate • Samurai • Duelist • Experienced 3 • Unique
After you Proclaim another Personality: Gain 1 Honor.
Iaijutsu Battle: Hakuseki challenges a target enemy Personality. Bow the duel's loser. Destroy the duel's loser if the duel was against The Dark Naga.

name: Kakita Hideo, the Fallen Keeper
flavour:
Can that truly be the same Kakita Hideo from Ayano-Sensei's tales?
Jun'ai looked grim. "Not every man breaks in the same way."
text:
Crane Clan • Fallen • Keeper of Obsidian • Samurai • Duelist • Experienced 2 • Unique
After Hideo enters play, lose 3 Honor.
After Hideo wins a duel, give him two +1F tokens.

name: Kakita Ichigiku - exp
flavour: For all her serenity, there is something inside her that she refuses to show the world. Perhaps that is why I find her so fascinating. - Kitsuki Kinaro
text:
Crane Clan • Magistrate • Samurai • Duelist • Experienced • Unique
Battle: If no other player has more Family Honor than you, give Ichigiku +3F, or +4F if you control Kitsuki Kinaro.

name: Doji Hoturi - inexp
flavour: The scion of the Crane slew a thing that wore his face. What does that do to a man?
text:
Crane Clan • Clan Champion • Samurai • Duelist • Inexperienced • Loyal • Unique
Iaijutsu Battle: Hoturi challenges a target Personality. If the target is honorable, his controller may dishonor him and move him home to refuse the duel. Destroy the duel's loser.

name: Daidoji Adachi
flavour: Animals! You are all animals!
text:
Crane Clan • Fallen • Samurai • Scout
After Adachi enters play, lose 2 Honor.
After an action from a card opposing Adachi resolves, if its unit's Personality has more Madness tokens than printed Personal Honor, his controller discards a card.

name: Kitsuki Daisuke - exp2
flavour: What an amusing testimony. Suikihime-sama may not be as amused, I fear.
text:
Dragon Clan • Courtier • Magistrate • Duelist • Experienced 2 • Unique
Limited: Look at the top three cards of your Fate deck. If you find an Iaijutsu Strategy, you may show it, put it into your hand, then discard a card. Put the remaining cards back in any order.

name: Kitsuki Kinaro - exp
flavour: No one has ever accepted me for who I am. No one. Except for him. - Kakita Ichigiku
text:
Dragon Clan • Courtier • Magistrate • Duelist • Experienced • Unique
Iaijutsu Open, [BOW]: Bow a target Personality with lower Personal Honor. Gain 1 Honor if you control Kakita Ichigiku.

name: Mirumoto Kazuya
flavour: Behold. The true nature of the world.
text:
Dragon Clan • Fallen • Samurai • Expendable • Kensai
(Draw a card after your Expendable card is destroyed.)
After Kazuya enters play, lose 2 Honor.

name: Togashi Mitsu - inexp
flavour: Born of the world, but with a soul unlike any outside the Heavens. Never another like him shall there be. - Mirumoto Shikei
text:
Dragon Clan • Fire • Monk • Samurai • Tattooed • Inexperienced • Unique
Fire Battle/Open: Give Mitsu +1F Fire tokens until he has exactly five.
Fire Battle: Destroy zero or more Fire tokens on Mitsu. Ranged Attack with strength equal to the number of tokens destroyed.

name: Togashi Noboru, the Shattered Star
flavour: Father was a fool to cast this aside. I alone know what is best.
text:
Dragon Clan • Fallen • Fire • Monk • Tattooed • Experienced • Unique
After Noboru enters play, lose 3 Honor.
Fire Battle: Bow a target enemy Personality. Give Noboru a Force bonus equal to the target's Force.

name: Akodo Tsudoken - exp2
flavour: The light in his eyes was not fire, but something darker.
text:
Lion Clan • Commander • Fallen • Samurai • Experienced 2 • Unique
After Tsudoken enters play: Lose 3 Honor.
Tireless Battle/Open: Straighten your target Lion Clan or Fallen Personality. (You may use Tireless abilities even if bowed.)

name: Ikoma Aimi - exp
flavour: Change is something that cannot be avoided, Iaimiko. Still, we should ever strive to retain those things which are honorable, and resist those things which are not. Only then can we be truly pure.
text:
Lion Clan • Courtier • Samurai • Experienced • Unique
Political Limited, [BOW]: Discard a card. Gain Honor equal to its Focus Value, plus 1 if Shiba Iaimiko is in play.

name: Ikoma Natsu - exp
flavour: The Unicorn may be astonished to hear this, but we too breed horses.
text:
Lion Clan • Magistrate • Samurai • Warden • Cavalry • Experienced • Unique
Natsu will not join a Unicorn Clan player.
Open: Give a target Personality Cavalry.

name: Ikoma Ayumi
flavour: I have no choice. It's bigger than us. You cannot stop what is coming...
text:
Lion Clan • Fallen • Magistrate • Samurai • Cavalry • Expendable
(Draw a card after your Expendable card is destroyed.)
After Ayumi enters play, lose 2 Honor.

name: Matsu Nimuro - exp2
flavour: A single mistake cannot wash away a life of honor and glory. The Golden Lion will forever be remembered among our greatest heroes. - Akodo Dairuko
text:
Lion Clan • Clan Champion • Samurai • Duelist • Experienced 2 • Loyal • Tactician • Unique
Nimuro's printed ability will not be copied.
Limited: Once per game, create a Personality titled The False Nimuro with Nimuro's printed Force, Chi, Personal Honor, and keywords.

name: Yoritomo Tonogi
flavour: They are mine. Understand? All of this is mine!
text:
Mantis Clan • Fallen • Magistrate • Samurai • Expendable • Naval
(Draw a card after your Expendable card is destroyed.)
After Tonogi enters play, lose 2 Honor.

name: Moshi Tomiko - exp
flavour: Friend Moto-san, I pray that the Fortunes watch over you in your distant land. I fear for your sanity, and that of all those who suffer the curse of P'an Ku's attentions...
text:
Mantis Clan • Thunder • Experienced • Naval • Shugenja • Unique
Limited: Bow your target unbowed Ring or Moto Ming-Gwok. Draw a card.

name: Tsuruchi - inexp
flavour: Who could think a man called the Little Wasp could be such a perfect master of death? - Yoritomo Hiromi

Mantis Clan • Wasp Clan • Daimyo • Master Bowman • Samurai • Scout • Inexperienced • Unique

Battle: Destroy zero or more Arrow tokens on Tsuruchi. Ranged Attack with strength equal to twice the number of tokens destroyed. You may use this action three times per turn.

name: Yoritomo Kanaye - exp
flavour: The dark veil of the future parted for the magistrates, and they witnessed men transformed into monstrosities who feasted on violence and blood.
text:
Mantis Clan • Brute • Extortionist • Fallen • Magistrate • Samurai • Experienced • Naval • Unique
After Kanaye enters play: Lose 3 Honor.
Actions on your Strategies cost 1 less Gold.

text: Open: Target two of your Personalities. A lesson is taught. One copies Commander, Duelist, Kensai, Magistrate, Paragon, Scout, or Yojimbo from the other.

name: Puppet Theater Troupe
flavour: One of the most commonly requested performances of the season was a rather scandalous account of Kuni Renyu's rivalry with Togashi Noboru.
text: Political Open, [BOW]: If the active player has 11 or more Family Honor, he loses 1 Honor.

name: Secret Dojo
flavour: I always thought this was a tax warehouse, she commented. Behind the blindfold, he smiled. "Let us begin."
text:
Dojo
Interrupt, [BOW]: Bow the winner of any duel created by the action if he was the Challenger. Destroy this Holding.

name: Slave Pits
flavour: There are dark places in the Empire, far from the Jade Sun's light, where unsavory practices remain in place.
text:
Mine
Courtesy: When this Holding produces Gold, you may give it +1GP (this turn) and lose 2 Honor. (Courtesy traits do not take effect if you went first.)

name: Throes of Madness
flavour: The Mad Dragon will return one day! He laughed. "The faithful will be ready!"
text:
Kharmic
Open, [BOW]: Straighten your target Personality. Destroy this Holding.
Open, [BOW]: Straighten this Holding if you have not given any Madness tokens this turn. Give a target Personality a Madness token.

name: Blessed Herbalist
flavour: Try to remain still, brother. The kami will heal you, if you let them.
text:
Expendable • Fortification
(Draw a card after your Expendable card is destroyed. Fortifications attach, bowed, to the Province from which they entered play.)
Tireless Interrupt: Negate all the action's Melee and Ranged Attacks (at this battlefield).

name: Mystic Dojo
flavour: The term dojo most often applies to schools for samurai to learn the ways of war. Most often, but not always.
text:
Dojo
This Holding has +2GP when it pays for a single Shugenja only.

name: Personal Dojo
flavour: Oh, I see you brought a no-dachi. That is so quaint. No, I certainly never have seen that before.
text:
Dojo
Tireless Interrupt: If you have won a duel this turn, each of the action's Fear effects have +1 strength and may target Items and Spells. (Tireless actions may be taken even while bowed.)

name: Nexus of Lies
flavour: To outsiders, it appears as a simple tower. To the Scorpion, it is the greatest repository of blackmail secrets in the world.
text: Before another, non-Spider Clan player loses Honor from a card he owns, increase the loss by an amount equal to half his Starting Family Honor, rounded down (this doesn't allow them to ignore Honor Requirements).

name: The Obsidian Dojo
flavour: If the other clans think us only what we appear to be, they are fools. - Daigotsu Kanpeki
text:
Dojo
Interrupt, [BOW]: If the action creates a duel, then after your Personality wins it permanently give him the ability, "Battle: Fear 4 (Bow a target enemy Follower or Personality without Followers with 4 or lower Force)." Destroy this Holding.

name: Platinum Mine
flavour: Incredibly rare and found mostly in the Colonies, platinum is valuable enough to tempt even the most virtuous soul.
text:
Mine
This Holding has +1GP when it pays for a single attachment only.

name: Forward Encampment
flavour: We may only be here a month, the commander said, "but I won't have our horses wandering. Fences, men. Defensive and containment."
text:
Barracks
Battle, [BOW], [PAY *]: Equip a target Follower or Spell in your discard pile if another player's action destroyed it or its Personality this battle.

name: Agasha Tameko
flavour: Are the Unicorn truly surprised that their repulsive ancestry may have stained their souls? If so, they are more naive than I imagined.
text:
Commander • Water • Shugenja • Soul of Agasha Tomioko
Water Interrupt: After the action Equips a Spell to Tameko, take an additional action.

name: Walking with the Fire
flavour: The designs of the kami are majestic, of that there is no doubt. It can be difficult to endure their beauty, though.
text:
Kharmic
Battle/Open: Straighten your target Ring.
Fire Interrupt: Bow your target unbowed Ring. After revealing focused cards in a duel created by the action, give the first card you focused in the duel +2FV.

name: Small Library
flavour: We have but a fraction of the records of a larger library, sama, but you will find all our scrolls in perfect condition. We all do what we must.
text:
Library
After this card enters play from a Province, refill the Province face-up.

name: Kaiu-Built Defenses
flavour: If there is ever a chance it will be attacked, do yourself a favor and commission a Kaiu. - Common saying among governors
text:
Fortification
This Holding enters play unbowed.
Interrupt, [BOW]: Negate an Engage action.
Battle, [BOW]: Ranged 3 Attack.

name: Chaldera
flavour: This world belongs to the humans now. The fate that has befallen my people is tragic, but who are we to questions fate? It is what it is.
text:
Constrictor • Naga • Nonhuman
Battle: Bow a target enemy Personality with lower Force and with either no unbowed Followers or Shadowlands.

name: Suana Dojo
flavour: Few heroes of the Brotherhood have such a reputation as Suana. A man of peace and introspection, once he was moved to battle, he wan an unstoppable juggernaut.
text:
Dojo
This Holding has -1GP while your Stronghold's Gold Production is 4 or greater.

name: Doji Masachika
flavour: Perhaps it is an unlucky name, he admitted. He smiled. "Unlucky for you."
text:
Magistrate • Samurai • Expendable
(Draw a card after your Expendable card dies.)
Interrupt: After Masachika enters play, dishonor a target Personality with equal or lower Personal Honor.

name: Iuchi Daitoru
flavour: Many underestimate the Unicorn magistrates because of their compassionate nature. It is due to this compassion that they are so driven to find and punish the guilty and the wicked, however.
text: Magistrate • Shugenja • Water

name: Temple of Destiny
flavour: Destiny is an idea that everyone accepts, but which few truly understand. Those few who dedicate themselves to unraveling its mysteries are often lost to others.
text:
Temple • Destined
(Draw a card after you Recruit a Destined card.)

name: Trading Grounds
flavour: Nothing in the mortal realm can compare to the chaos of the trading grounds during a coronation festival season.
text:
Market
This Holding has +3GP when it pays for a single Holding only.

name: Traveling Market
flavour: Many merchants believe that their customers will come to them. Others are not so patient, and are willing to go to the customer if the promise of coin is sufficient.
text: Market • Kharmic

name: Labor Crew
flavour: Celebration or not, this trench must be dug. Do you relish the thought of cavalry overrunning the village? No? Then dig!
text:
Fortification
(Fortifications attach, bowed, to the Province from which they entered play.)
Interrupt, [BOW]: Negate a target Personality's movement into an attacking army.

name: Yukihime's Hot Springs
flavour: I do not know about you, friends, but all this talk of coronation has me in need of a long, soothing soak in the springs.
text: Open, [BOW]: A target Holding's abilities may not be used.

name: Hida Taisho
flavour: As for myself, I care little who sits on the throne. I am but a soldier, and I will never be in his presence. I wage war on the Shadowlands, and that is all.
text:
Samurai
Battle, [BOW]: Reduce a target enemy Follower or Personality's Force by Taisho's Force.

name: Hida Zaiburo
flavour: You have served well despite your curse, brother. I swear to you, and to our parents in the next world, I will find a way to end your life. Trust me, Kaiji.
text:
Berserker • Conqueror
(A Conqueror's unit doesn't bow after battle.)
Battle: Fear equal to Zaiburo's Force minus 1.

name: Toritaka Iabuchi
flavour: My power is not for myself, great Fortunes, but for our new Emperor. Give them your wisdom and your insight, that he may reign with justice.
text:
Samurai • Scout • Destined
(Draw a card after you Recruit a Destined card.)
Battle, [BOW]: Ranged 2 Attack (Destroy a target enemy Follower or Personality without Followers with 2 or lower Force).

name: Hida Iguchi
flavour: Iguchi shook the dust of the trail from his thick beard. "Will I be going to the Imperial City?" he asked. "What kind of question is that?"
text:
Samurai • Cavalry
(Once per turn, as an Absent Engage, move your unbowed Personality in a Cavalry unit to the battle.)

name: Hida Kurabi
flavour: All Imperials are reqruired in the capital for the coronation. He crumpled up the scroll. "Wonderful."
text:
Berserker • Hero • Imperial • Destined • Reserve
(Draw a card after you Recruit a Destined card. You may Recruit a Reserve Personality, if they would be opposed, as an Absent Battle action.)

name: Hiruma Raikohime
flavour: The Kokujin monks have returned, Shara-sensei. I swear to you, I will end them.
text:
Magistrate • Samurai • Resilient
(Once per game per card, a Resilient card does not die in battle resolution.)
Engage: If Raikohime is opposed, discard a card to make the enemy leader either discard a Battle Strategy, or show you his hand if it does not have one.

name: Kaiu Burei
flavour: He inspected every single seam, spending hours upon hours supervising the work. The Kaiu were not known for their expertise without just cause.
text:
Samurai • Siege
Before you Proclaim Burei, increase the Honor gain to equal the number of your Fortifications in play, up to 5.

name: Kaiu Daikohime
flavour: What simpleton drew up these plans? Look at these oversights. I could capture this fortification with a dozen men. No, this will not do at all.
text:
Samurai • Siege
Battle, [BOW]: If Daikohime is defending, Ranged 3 Attack. After this destroys a card, gain 1 Honor.

name: Kaiu Gorobei
flavour: Last night I was struck by inspiration! We will add an additional tower here, and link it with a second, internal wall. This shall be my most impregnable fortress yet.
text:
Samurai • Siege
Battle: Discard a card to bow a target enemy card with Force equal to or lower than the discarded card's Focus Value.

name: Kaiu Watsuki - exp
flavour: The construction seems to be ahead of schedule. I think the new Emperor will be very pleased.
text:
Daimyo • Samurai • Siege • Experienced • Loyal • Tactician • Unique
Interrupt: After the action Recruits a Fortification from a Province, refill it face-up.
Battle: Ranged 3 Attack with +1 strength for each Fortification at this battlefield.

name: Kuni Chutsu
flavour: He felt the spirits of the earth stirring all around him, taking notice of his deference and patience. Like the Crab, the Earth despised weakness and impatience. The priest smiled. "Thank you, my friends," he said softly.
text: Earth • Shugenja

name: Kuni Harakibi
flavour: The witch-hunter's make-up gleamed in the moonlight. "Tell me, friend Phoenix... where did you find these scrolls?"
text:
Earth • Shugenja • Witch Hunter
Earth Battle, [BOW]: Melee 3 Attack, or Melee 4 Attack if the target is Shadowlands (Destroy a target enemy Follower or Personality without Followers with Force equal to or lower than the Melee Attack's Strength).

name: Kuni Yairao
flavour: Celebration is never an excuse to allow your vigilance to waver. We must be strong because so many others are weak.
text:
Commander • Earth • Shugenja • Soul of Kuni Iyedo
Earth Battle, [PAY *]: Equip a target Follower in your hand to your target Personality.

name: Kuni Renyu - exp3
flavour: Since his return from the Colonies, many have noted that Renyu's temper has only worsened.
text:
Daimyo • Earth • Jade • Magistrate • Shugenja • Witch Hunter • Experienced 3 • Loyal • Unique
Earth Interrupt: If the action is Earth, negate the next straightening (this turn) of each card it bows.
Earth Unstoppable Battle: Bow a target enemy card that is Dragon Clan, Gaijin, Shadowlands, or has no attachments.

name: Asahina Hirakane
flavour: Whispering a prayer, the priest took the paper from the dead soldier's hand. "The Empire must hear this death poem," he whispered.
text:
Air • Shugenja • Soul of Asahina Minori
Open: Target another player's Personality. After the next time this turn he is destroyed during a battle, gain 2 Honor.

name: Kakita Mitsumichi
flavour: A man whose sword is always drawn is never approached. He has no allies. Yet a man who never draws his sword will find it rusting in its sheath. Seek balance in all things. - The Tao of Shinsei
text:
Samurai • Soul of Kakita Yariga • Duelist
(Duelists win tied duels versus non-Duelists.)
Mitsumichi will not refuse challenges. If Mitsumichi is honorable, the first card another player focuses in each duel against him is focused face-up.

name: Doji Senkiku
flavour: A wise lord would never risk fielding a disgraced man, even if that man was a master swordsman. It makes his enemy look virtuous. The battle is but a moment in time; the aftermath is an eternity. How easily victory sours, like spoiled milk.
text:
Samurai • Magistrate • Soul of Doji Hitomaro
Political Engage: If Senkiku opposes a dishonorable Personality, gain 2 Honor.

name: Kakita Akitomo
flavour: A man to be admired! Truly, this is the most glorious celebration Susumu-sama could have conceived without opening his coffers!
text:
Artisan • Courtier • Jester
Political Interrupt, [BOW]: If the action is yours, before you gain Honor from it, negate the gain to make a target player lose 1 Honor.

name: Daidoji Taenaru
flavour: The sensei asked, "Is it better to live well, or to die well?" Taenaru did not flinch. "Both," she replied.
text:
Samurai • Soul of Daidoji Tae
After Taenaru is destroyed, gain 2 Honor.
Battle: Once per battle, move home a target enemy Personality with lower current Force than his own printed Force. Bow him as he moves.

name: Doji Tashihime
flavour: Who wrote this!? the man demanded, the scroll clenched in his fist. His eyes raked the court. "Who is this 'Waratte?'" The daimyo looked away, and too late the man realized he'd been made a fool.
text:
Artisan • Poet • Soul of Doji Nukada
Political Interrupt: Before another player loses Honor from the action, Tashihime's poems immortalize the shame; increase the loss by 1 and gain 1 Honor.

name: Fearless Heavy Cavalry
flavour: A commander is fortunate who has such a force in his army. - Moto Taigo
text:
Cavalry
Negate Fear effects targeting this Follower.
Interrupt: If the action is yours, straighten this Follower after it resolves.

name: Shune
flavour: Kenku sightings in Crane lands are more common of late. Many take this is as sign of favor, of good fortune for the Crane. The Champion ponders before the shrine of Doji Yasuyo. He is not so certain.
text:
Kenku • Nonhuman • Duelist
Iaijutsu Battle: Target your unbowed Personality and bow him unless he has won a duel this turn. Bow a target enemy Personality with equal or lower Chi than your Personality.

name: Daidoji Hiroteru
flavour: To kill the spirit is the swiftest victory of all.
text:
Iron Crane • Samurai
Hiroteru has +1F for each bowed card in the enemy army.
Battle: Fear 3.

name: Doji Norime
flavour: You harbor a criminal in your army, Matsu-san. Were you aware of this?
text:
Magistrate • Samurai
Absent Home Battle: Move Norime into your defending army. After this moves her, you may target and bow an enemy dishonorable Personality. (Absent actions may be taken without presence. Home actions may be taken from home.)

name: Kakita Ikura
flavour: Such a charming, peaceful soul. But his music is so anguished... - Doji Makoto
text:
Artisan • Courtier • Cursed • Daimyo • Loyal • Unique
Ikura will not attack or issue challenges, and cannot be challenged from Iaijutsu actions.
Favor Political Open: Discard the Imperial Favor to make a target player lose 1 Honor.

name: Kakita Hikai
flavour: The Kakita Jester is a master entertainer. The ideal jester can dance, sing, compose spontaneous poetry, and amuse an audience without appearing like a buffoon. However, with all these talents, they are best known for their barbed wit.
text:
Artisan • Courtier • Jester • Expendable
(Draw a card after your Expendable card dies.)
After you Proclaim Hikai or he is destroyed, a target player loses 1 Honor.

name: Kakita Izumiko
flavour: One day, you are born. The next, you die. If you are lucky, sometime in-between you will glimpse the moon.
text:
Samurai • Duelist
(Duelists win tied duels versus non-Duelists.)
After Izumiko wins a duel, gain 1 Honor.

name: Kakita Ujirou - exp
flavour: The door was open, the dying Bayushi remarked. Ujirou shrugged and wiped blood from his blade.
text:
Magistrate • Samurai • Duelist • Experienced • Reserve • Unique
After Ujirou enters play, you may take an additional action. While you are the Defender, you Recruit Ujirou for 5 less Gold.
Battle: Fear 4 that destroys attachments and dishonorable Personalities after it bows them.

name: Mirumoto Akifumi
flavour: The first child or the second? An interesting, but useless question. It was never for us to choose who might be Emperor, only to wait until the great cycle reveals itself.
text:
Samurai • Void
Tireless Battle: Target your Ring. You may bow it to straighten Akifumi or you may bow Akifumi to straighten it. (Tireless actions may be taken even while bowed.)

name: Togashi Kasuru
flavour: Come, my friend. Let us share in the secrets of the universe together.
text:
Monk • Tattooed • Void • Tactician
(Battle: Discard a card to give this Tactician a Force bonus equal to the card's Focus Value.)
Battle, [BOW]: If Kasuru is attacking, draw a card. You may discard a card to straighten Kasuru.

name: Kitsuki Goichi
flavour: We were once allies with your kind, Scorpion, he said. "But that time has passed. Why would we support your foolish war?"
text:
Magistrate • Samurai • Soul of Kitsuki Berii
Battle: Move home a target Human Personality with the lowest Personal Honor at this battlefield (you choose in case of a tie).

name: Kitsuki Einosuke
flavour: Here, master, the student remarked. "This mark was placed to confuse us."
text:
Courtier • Magistrate • Expendable
(Draw a card after your Expendable card dies.)
Courtesy: Einosuke has Destined. (Courtesy traits do not take effect if you went first. Draw a card after you Recruit a Destined card.)

name: Mirumoto Eisuke
flavour: Matters with the Spider grow even more strained than before with the appointment of this new Emperor. They are an interesting people, and I would be saddened to cut them down. Saddened, but not worried.
text: Samurai • Soul of Mirumoto Daini

name: Kitsuki Masamitsu
flavour: Masamitsu's talents help train the next generation as well as lead to testimony that traps the guilty.
text:
Air • Courtier • Magistrate • Shugenja
Air Tireless Open: If Masamitsu has cast an Air Spell this turn, straighten him. (Tireless action may be taken even while bowed.)

name: Mirumoto Tsuda, Emerald Champion
flavour: The mad ones. The Fudoists. Bandits. Criminals. Many faces of the same foe, undone by the same weapon - justice.
text:
Imperial • Magistrate • Samurai • Cavalry • Duelist • Experienced • Unique
Iaijutsu Battle: Challenge a target enemy Personality. If the target is honorable, his controller may dishonor him and move him home to refuse the duel. Destroy the loser.

name: Mirumoto Rikiya
flavour: Peace in the Colonies, my friend. The Dragon will brook no more of this pointless conflict.
text:
Samurai • Soul of Mirumoto Washizuka • Duelist
Iaijutsu Battle, [BOW]: Move home a target enemy defending Personality with equal or lower Chi. Straighten Rikiya if he won a duel this turn.

name: Togashi Taiki
flavour: The ise zumi in the Colonies have taken great strides to bring harmony to the region.
text:
Monk • Tattooed
Taiki has the element keywords of any Rings you control. While you control a Ring of Air, he has Cavalry; Ring of Earth, he has +2F/+1C; Ring of Fire, he has, "Battle: Melee 2 Attack."; Ring of Water, he has Conqueror; Ring of Void, he has Destined • Expendable.

name: Tamori Tsunemi
flavour: A new Emperor sits on the Throne, and yet I know there will be little true rejoicing. Times like these make opportunists out of many souls.
text:
Commander • Earth • Shugenja • Conqueror
(A Conqueror's unit doesn't bow after battle.)

name: Tamori Jinai
flavour: The element of earth is common in all living things. While my temple may have no great wall of stone, it is guarded all the same.
text:
Alchemist • Earth • Shugenja
Earth Battle: Bow a target enemy card without attachments.

name: Tamori Seiken - exp
flavour: Seiken burst from the ground itself, propelled by his steed of stone. The Scorpion ambush was scattered, and the Dragon made their presence known.
text:
Commander • Earth • Mountaineer • Shugenja • Cavalry • Experienced • Unique
Seiken's Nonhuman Followers have Cavalry.
Earth Battle: Fear equal to the Focus Value of Seiken's target Follower or Spell.

name: Tamori Shoko
flavour: Hello, my enemies. I have a gift for you. Where shall I place it?
text:
Commander • Earth • Shugenja
Earth Battle: Give a target enemy Follower or Personality -2F.

name: Togashi Tsukagi
flavour: The pattern holds. A fall, a rise. A man learns the cost of his bargain. There will be a break from within, and a storm will rip apart our very hearts. Pain and rage await us all, and I can unleash myself. Pain and rage. For myself and for my enemies.
text: Monk • Soul of Togashi Akagi • Tattooed • Void

name: Akodo Kenaro - exp
flavour: You served the Empress with honor, father. I shall serve her son in the same fashion.
text:
Samurai • Duelist • Experienced • Tactician • Unique
After your Personality wins a duel at a battlefield, give him +1F.
Iaijutsu Battle: Kenaro challenges a target enemy Personality. Bow the loser.

name: Akodo Hio
flavour: The insults suffered due to the offenses of the Scorpion would not be borne lightly by the Lion. The sons of Akodo and daughters of Matsu were not those who endured such things without answer.
text:
Beastmaster • Samurai • Soul of Akodo Michio
Battle, [PAY 2]: Discard a card to create a 2F Cat • Nonhuman Follower and attach it to your target Beastmaster.

name: Matsu Iairimi
flavour: She carries an unconventional weapon, but it is one that the Scorpion have learned to fear. Many of their kinsmen's blood is upon it. - Ikoma Sairei
text:
Hero • Samurai • Soul of Matsu Mari
Interrupt: Negate Iairimi's movement from the action.

name: Akodo Shaido
flavour: There are few families in Rokugan who place as great an emphasis on education as the Akodo. The overwhelming emphasis is on warfare, of course, but other subjects are covered as well.
text:
Samurai • Duelist
(Duelists win tied duels versus non-Duelists.)
Shaido has +1F and +1PH while attacking.

name: Ikoma Sairei
flavour: As the Lion pushed farther into Scorpion territory, many strange things were discovered. "What are you doing here, cousin?" he asked the large cat, but of course it did not answer.
text: Paragon • Samurai • Soul of Ikoma Sido

name: Matsu Ataruko
flavour: It is said her mother is Matsu Benika, bearer of the Jade Hand. I do not know if this is true, but she possesses insight such as no warrior I have ever known. - Akodo Kano
text:
Beastmaster • Commander • Samurai
Battle: Fear 2, or Fear 4 if Ataruko has a Nonhuman, non-Shadowlands Follower.

name: Ikoma Noritsu
flavour: His uncle bore the blessings of Bishamon himself, the Fortune of Strength. Some say he possesses it as well.
text:
Samurai • Soul of Ikoma Tatsunori • Tactician
(Battle: Discard a card to give this Tactician a Force bonus equal to the card's Focus Value.)
Political Interrupt: Before you gain Honor from a Battle action, negate the gain to draw a card.

name: Matsu Keiasu
flavour: By the Fortunes, he's a fast one! How does he keep up with the beasts? - Ikoma Noritsu
text:
Beastmaster • Commander • Samurai • Cavalry
(Once per turn, as an Absent Engage, move your unbowed Personality in a Cavalry unit to the battle.)
Keiasu's Nonhuman, non-Shadowlands Followers have Cavalry.

name: Akodo Eirasu
flavour: Second generation Deathseekers are virtually unheard of, but then again, the unheard grows increasingly common.
text:
Deathseeker • Hero • Samurai • Soul of Akodo Ebiro
Battle: Fear equal to Eirasu's Force that bows any Undead card it targets. (Target an enemy Follower or Personality without Followers; bow it if its Force is less than or equal to the Fear's strength.)

name: Akodo Naikiru
flavour: Not all of us are called to serve in the same manner. I would gladly carry a blade into battle for my lord, but my duty is to govern, and I will do it with all that I have.
text:
Governor • Samurai • Soul of Akodo Nakama • Tactician
Your Bushido Virtue Strategies in and out of play have +1FV, to a maximum of 4.

name: Matsu Chizuki
flavour: She speaks to cats in a manner I cannot understand. Never ask after her father. - Akodo Dairuko
text:
Beastmaster • Commander • Daimyo • Samurai • Conqueror • Loyal • Unique
Melee Attacks and Fear effects from Cat Followers in this army have +1 strength.
Interrupt: After Chizuki enters play, search your Fate deck for Zaiko, show it, and put it in your hand.

name: Matsu Seijuko
flavour: My ancestor was called the Golden Crane for his skill in dueling. I venerate his memory, but call me a Crane and we shall cross steel.
text:
Samurai • Duelist
(Duelists win tied duels versus non-Duelists.)
After Seijuko wins a duel, give her +1PH.
Battle: Fear equal to Seijuko's Personal Honor.

name: Akodo Taiketsu
flavour: His face registered disappointment as he sheathed his blade. Yet another opponent had failed to give him challenge.
text:
Samurai • Duelist
(Duelists win tied duels versus non-Duelists.)
Invest [PAY 2]: Put an Iaijutsu Strategy in your discard pile into your hand. (Entering play, permanently increase the Gold Cost by the Invest cost to get the effect.)

name: Matsu Karoko
flavour: You will be my chief implement of vengeance upon these filthy Scorpion, Chizuki said with a smile. "Teach them what it means to cross the Matsu."
text:
Samurai
Battle, [BOW]: Melee 3 Attack. Straighten Karoko if she is attacking.

name: Moshi Karuiko
flavour: My mother earned great glory for the Mantis in battle against the Destroyers. I seek only to serve in a similar manner. How can a simple priestess cause an Empire to take note?
text: Shugenja • Thunder • Soul of Moshi Kamiya

name: Sarassa
flavour: Your actions, human... they have effect far beyond that which you can see.
text:
Ningyo • Nonhuman • Shugenja • Thunder • Naval
(Once a turn, the Attacker gets the first Battle action, if it's from a Naval Personality's unit.)
Thunder Battle, [PAY *]: Equip a target Spell to Sarassa. You may take an additional action to use one of the Spell's Battle abilities.

name: Moshi Yokohime
flavour: I witnessed the death of a Phoenix through his own eyes. Lady Ikako, I need to understand.
text:
Shugenja • Soul of Moshi Yuriko • Thunder • Naval
(Once a turn, the Attacker gets the first Battle action, if it's from a Naval Personality's unit.)
Thunder Battle: Bow a target enemy card without attachments.

name: Moshi Ikako - exp
flavour: Regardless of the new Emperor's preferences, I will not see the Moshi lose their way.
text:
Air • Fire • Daimyo • Shugenja • Experienced • Naval • Reserve • Unique
Your other Moshi Personalities in Ikako's army have +1F. After Ikako enters play, you may take an additional action.
Fire Battle: Ranged Attack equal to 2 plus the number of other Personalities in this army.

name: Tsuruchi Arayo
flavour: It is said that her grandmother was born of the Daidoji, and it is in her memory that she wears such an odd helm.
text:
Samurai • Soul of Tsuruchi Amaya
Battle, [BOW]: Ranged 4 Attack. Bow the target if it is still in play.

name: Tsuruchi Jinrai
flavour: I enjoyed killing the Crane, but I think I would like to try a different prey.
text:
Magistrate • Samurai • Soul of Tsuruchi Jougo
Battle, [BOW]: Ranged 3 Attack. You may target a Mantis Clan Personality in one of your Provinces and reduce his Gold Cost by 2 (this turn), to a minimum of 3.

name: Yoritomo Kuniken
